label: 다시 뒤집으려 버둥거린다
success_text: 몇 번이고 버둥거린 끝에 다시 뒤집혔습니다. 어머니가 웃음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: After wriggling again and again, you roll over once more. Your mother bursts out laughing.
fail_text: 힘이 빠져 엎어진 채 한참을 울었습니다.
fail_text_en: Your strength gives out, and you cry facedown for a long time.

label: 엄마를 보며 방긋 웃는다
success_text: 방긋 웃어 보이자 옆집 아주머니까지 달려와 감탄했습니다.
success_text_en: You flash a smile, and even the neighbor lady rushes over to marvel.

label: 그대로 잠이 든다
success_text_en: With a full belly, you drift off in no time.

label: 손뼉 소리에 놀라 운다
label_en: Cry at the sound of clapping
success_text: 놀란 울음은 곧 젖을 물고 잦아들었습니다.
success_text_en: Your startled crying soon fades at the breast.
fail_text: 손뼉 소리에 놀라 더 크게 울음을 터뜨렸습니다.
fail_text_en: Startled by the clapping, you wail even louder.

label: 크게 울어 젖을 달라고 한다
success_text_en: At your cries, your mother hurriedly nurses you.
fail_text: 울다 지친 어머니가 한숨을 쉬며 달래는 소리에 잠이 듭니다.
fail_text_en: Exhausted by your crying, your mother sighs and soothes you, and you fall asleep.

label: 손가락을 빨며 참는다
label_en: Suck your fingers and hold out
success_text: 손가락을 빨며 꾹 참자 어머니가 쪽잠을 청할 수 있었습니다.
success_text_en: You suck your fingers and hold out, letting your mother catch a short nap.

label: 옹알이로 부모를 부른다
success_text: 옹알이에 부모가 화답하며 방 안이 따뜻해집니다.
success_text_en: Your parents babble back, and the room grows warm.
fail_text: 옹알이를 알아듣지 못한 부모는 피곤한 얼굴로 돌아눕습니다.
fail_text_en: Not understanding your babbling, your parents roll over with tired faces.

label: 어둠 속 무언가를 가만히 바라본다
label_en: Stare quietly at something in the dark
success_text: 어둠 속 희미한 빛에 마음이 이상하게 편안해집니다.
success_text_en: A faint light in the dark brings you a strange calm.
fail_text: 어둠 속 그림자가 무서워 울음이 터집니다.
fail_text_en: The shadows in the dark frighten you, and you burst into tears.

label: 활짝 웃어 보인다
success_text_en: The delighted guest presses a candy into your hand.

label: 자지러지게 운다
success_text: 울음소리에 손님이 당황해 얼른 안겨 줄 사람을 찾습니다.
success_text_en: Flustered by your crying, the guest hurriedly looks for someone to hand you to.
fail_text: 울음소리에 집 안이 시끄러워져 손님이 서둘러 떠납니다.
fail_text_en: Your crying fills the house, and the guest leaves in a hurry.

label: 손님의 반짝이는 반지를 움켜쥔다
success_text: 반지를 움켜쥔 손을 떼지 않자 손님은 웃으며 반지를 빼 줍니다.
success_text_en: You won't let go of the ring, so the guest laughs and slips it off for you.
fail_text_en: You grab the ring and get scolded by the guest.

label: 가만히 손님의 눈을 응시한다
label_en: Stare quietly into the guest's eyes
success_text: 손님은 아이의 눈빛에 마음이 흔들린 듯 말없이 웃습니다.
success_text_en: Moved by the child's gaze, the guest smiles without a word.
fail_text_en: The guest looks away, embarrassed.

label: 지폐
success_text: 지폐를 잡자 온 가족이 부자가 될 거라며 환호합니다.
success_text_en: You grab the banknote, and the whole family cheers that you will be rich.
fail_text: 지폐가 찢어져 손에 쥔 것은 반쪽뿐입니다.
fail_text_en: The bill tears, and you are left holding only half.

label: 연필
success_text: 연필을 쥔 아이에게 아버지가 공부를 시키겠다고 선언합니다.
success_text_en: Seeing you clutch the pencil, your father declares you will be educated.
fail_text_en: The pencil snaps, and the party is thrown into brief disarray.

label: 실타래
success_text: 실타래를 잡자 할머니가 장수를 빌어 주십니다.
success_text_en: You grab the thread, and your grandmother prays for your long life.
fail_text: 실이 엉켜 할머니가 한참 풀어 주십니다.
fail_text_en: The thread tangles, and your grandmother spends ages unraveling it.

label: 묵주
success_text: 묵주를 잡자 성당에 다니던 할머니가 눈물을 글썽입니다.
success_text_en: You grab the rosary, and your churchgoing grandmother's eyes well up.
fail_text_en: You drop the rosary on the floor.

label: 넘어져도 다시 일어난다
label_en: Get back up when you fall
success_text: 넘어져도 다시 일어나자 마루에서 박수가 쏟아집니다.
success_text_en: You fall and get back up, and applause fills the room.
fail_text: 무릎이 까져 마루에 피가 조금 묻습니다.
fail_text_en: You scrape your knee, leaving a little blood on the floor.

label: 엄마 손을 꼭 잡고 걷는다
success_text: 엄마 손을 잡고 걷자 이웃들이 예쁘다며 칭찬합니다.
success_text_en: Walking hand in hand with Mom, you win the neighbors' praise for how cute you are.

label: 기어서 가는 게 편하다
success_text: 기어 다니며 간식통까지 가는 길을 익힙니다.
success_text_en: Crawling around, you learn the way to the snack tin.

label: 넘어지자 울음을 터뜨린다
label_en: Burst into tears when you fall
success_text_en: Your parents rush over at your cries and pick you up.
fail_text_en: Your wailing carries all the way down the alley.

label: 따라서 옹알거린다
success_text: 옹알이로 따라 부르자 아빠가 신이 나서 노래를 이어 갑니다.
success_text_en: You babble along, and your delighted father keeps singing.
fail_text_en: Your father stops singing and laughs at your babbling.

label: 금세 잠든다
success_text_en: Your father's song puts you to sleep in no time.

label: 노래가 끝날 때까지 눈을 뜨고 있다
label_en: Keep your eyes open until the song ends
success_text: 끝까지 노래를 듣다 보니 어쩐지 마음이 차분해집니다.
success_text_en: Listening to the very end, you feel oddly calm.
fail_text_en: You fight off sleep and end up fussing.

label: 노래 사이로 다른 목소리를 듣는다
label_en: Hear another voice between the verses
success_text: 라디오 잡음 사이에서 낯선 목소리가 들리는 듯합니다.
success_text_en: You seem to hear a strange voice through the radio static.
fail_text_en: There is only static, nothing more.

label: 밤새 앓다 아침에 털고 일어난다
label_en: Suffer all night and shake it off by morning
success_text_en: The fever breaks with the morning sun.
fail_text: 열은 내렸지만 기운이 한참 빠져 있습니다.
fail_text_en: The fever is gone, but your strength takes a long time to return.

label: 오래도록 낫지 않는다
label_en: It lingers for a long time
success_text: 한동안 병원 신세를 지며 집안 살림이 쪼들립니다.
success_text_en: You spend a long stretch in the hospital, and the household budget grows tight.

label: 부모 품에서 안정을 찾는다
label_en: Find comfort in your parents' arms
success_text: 부모가 번갈아 안아 주며 밤을 지새웁니다.
success_text_en: Your parents take turns holding you through the night.

label: 꿈속에서 빛나는 손이 이마를 짚는다
label_en: A glowing hand touches your forehead in a dream
success_text: 꿈속 빛나는 손이 이마를 짚자 열이 꿈처럼 가라앉습니다.
success_text_en: A glowing hand touches your forehead in a dream, and the fever fades like a dream.
fail_text: 꿈에서 깨자 더 뜨거운 열이 몰려옵니다.
fail_text_en: You wake from the dream, and an even hotter fever surges in.

label: 울면서 되찾으려 든다
label_en: Cry and try to get it back
success_text_en: After crying and clinging, you get the car back.
fail_text: 형은 더 세게 밀치고 자동차는 멀리 굴러갑니다.
fail_text_en: Your brother shoves you harder, and the car rolls far away.

label: 다른 장난감을 찾는다
success_text: 양철 인형을 꺼내 노는 사이 자동차 생각은 잊었습니다.
success_text_en: You play with the tin doll and forget all about the car.

label: 상대를 깨물어 버린다
success_text: 형이 비명을 지르며 자동차를 던지고 달아납니다.
success_text_en: Your brother yelps, throws the car, and runs off.
fail_text: 형에게 호되게 맞고 어머니께 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: Your brother beats you soundly, and your mother scolds you.

label: 그냥 웃어넘긴다
success_text_en: Your brother sheepishly gives back the car.
fail_text: 형이 더 신이 나 장난을 칩니다.
fail_text_en: Your brother, egged on, teases you even more.

label: 주먹을 꼭 쥔다
success_text: 주먹을 꼭 쥐자 할머니가 대견하다며 웃으십니다.
success_text_en: You clench your fist, and your grandmother smiles proudly.

label: 손을 활짝 편다
success_text: 할머니가 손금을 보고 큰 인물이 될 거라 하십니다.
success_text_en: Reading your palm, your grandmother says you will become someone great.
fail_text_en: Your grandmother just smiles and lets go of your hand.

label: 할머니 손가락을 잡는다
success_text: 할머니 손가락을 꼭 잡자 할머니가 눈가를 훔치십니다.
success_text_en: You clutch your grandmother's finger, and she dabs at her eyes.

label: 하품을 한다
success_text: 하품하는 모습에 할머니가 방을 치워 주십니다.
success_text_en: Seeing you yawn, your grandmother tidies the room for you.

label: 엄마
success_text_en: At the single word "Mama," your mother laughs through her tears.
fail_text: 엄마 목소리가 뉴스 소리에 묻혀 버립니다.
fail_text_en: Your little voice is drowned out by the news.

label: 아빠
success_text_en: Your father lifts you up with a joyful face.
fail_text_en: Your father is glued to the television and doesn't answer.

label: 맘마
success_text: 밥 달라는 말에 온 가족이 웃음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: At your plea for food, the whole family bursts out laughing.
fail_text_en: Your meal comes a little late.

label: 알 수 없는 단어를 중얼거린다
success_text: 알 수 없는 말을 중얼거리자 가족들이 신기해하며 귀를 기울입니다.
success_text_en: You mumble something unintelligible, and your family leans in, fascinated.
fail_text_en: No one understands you, and you sulk.

label: 그릇까지 핥아 먹는다
success_text: 그릇까지 싹싹 비우자 어머니가 흐뭇하게 웃습니다.
success_text_en: You scrape the bowl clean, and your mother smiles with satisfaction.

label: 퉤 뱉어 버린다
success_text_en: Gruel dribbles down your bib.
fail_text: 뱉은 미음이 얼굴에 튀어 한바탕 소동이 납니다.
fail_text_en: The spat-out gruel splatters your face, and chaos ensues.

label: 숟가락을 빼앗아 스스로 먹으려 한다
label_en: Grab the spoon and feed yourself
success_text: 숟가락질이 서툴지만 혼자 먹으려는 기세가 대단합니다.
success_text_en: Your spoon work is clumsy, but your determination to eat alone is impressive.
fail_text: 숟가락이 튀어 어머니 얼굴에 미음이 묻습니다.
fail_text_en: The spoon flips, and gruel lands on your mother's face.

label: 조금 먹고 고개를 돌린다
label_en: Eat a little and turn away
success_text_en: You eat just enough and look content.

label: 크게 울어 다툼을 멈춘다
label_en: Cry loudly to stop the fight
success_text_en: At your crying, your quarreling parents pause.
fail_text: 울음소리가 더 커져 부모가 더 크게 다툽니다.
fail_text_en: Your crying grows louder, and your parents fight even louder.

label: 이불 속에서 숨죽인다
label_en: Hold your breath under the blanket
success_text_en: You lie still, and the fight quietly dies down.
fail_text: 숨을 죽인 채 한참을 떨고 있습니다.
fail_text_en: You lie trembling, holding your breath, for a long time.

label: 다시 잠든다
success_text: 다시 잠에 들며 다툼 소리가 꿈결처럼 멀어집니다.
success_text_en: As you drift back to sleep, the quarrel fades away like a dream.

label: 두 사람에게 기어간다
success_text: 기어가 두 사람 사이에 드러눕자 부모가 멋쩍게 웃습니다.
success_text_en: You crawl over and lie down between them, and your parents smile sheepishly.
fail_text: 발에 걸려 두 사람 모두에게 야단을 맞습니다.
fail_text_en: You trip them up and both of them scold you.

label: 소리 나는 쪽을 바라본다
success_text_en: You gaze wide-eyed toward the ringing bells.

label: 종소리를 따라 손뼉을 친다
success_text_en: You clap and hum along with the bells.

label: 무서워 운다
success_text_en: The bells are so loud you burst into tears.
fail_text: 울음이 그치지 않아 한참을 안고 달래야 합니다.
fail_text_en: Your crying won't stop, and someone has to hold and soothe you for ages.

label: 종소리에 맞춰 잠든다
success_text_en: The gentle bells lull you to sleep.

label: 집주인에게 방긋 웃는다
success_text: 집주인이 웃음에 누그러져 세를 조금 미뤄 줍니다.
success_text_en: Softened by your smile, the landlord lets the rent slide a little.
fail_text_en: The landlord leaves without a smile.

label: 엄마 치맛자락을 붙잡는다
success_text: 어머니가 한숨을 쉬며 아이를 안아 듭니다.
success_text_en: Your mother sighs and picks you up.

label: 집주인의 지갑을 잡아당긴다
success_text: 지갑 끈을 쥐자 집주인이 깜짝 놀라 지갑을 놓칩니다.
success_text_en: You grab the wallet strap, and the startled landlord drops it.
fail_text: 집주인이 크게 화를 내며 셋방을 빼라고 합니다.
fail_text_en: The landlord flies into a rage and tells you to vacate the room.

label: 이불 속으로 숨는다
success_text: 이불 속에서 집주인 목소리가 멀어지길 기다립니다.
success_text_en: Under the blanket, you wait for the landlord's voice to fade.

label: 첨벙첨벙 신나게 논다
success_text_en: You kick and splash with glee.

label: 물을 무서워한다
success_text: 물가에서 조금 떨어진 곳에 앉아 있습니다.
success_text_en: You sit a little way back from the water's edge.
fail_text_en: Frightened of the water, you cry for a long time.

label: 물을 꿀꺽 마신다
success_text: 물을 꿀꺽 삼켜 기침을 콜록콜록 합니다.
success_text_en: You swallow a mouthful of water and cough and sputter.
fail_text: 배 속이 쓰려 한참을 누워 있습니다.
fail_text_en: Your stomach aches, and you lie down for a long time.

label: 물 위에 비친 빛을 오래 바라본다
label_en: Gaze long at the light on the water
success_text_en: The glittering water clears your mind.
fail_text_en: The dazzling water makes you burst into tears.

label: 받아서 먹는다
success_text_en: Your face lights up at the sweet taste.

label: 반으로 나눠 준다
success_text_en: You share the candy, and the kid is pleased.
fail_text_en: The kid pouts that their half is smaller.

label: 사탕을 더 달라고 조른다
success_text: 조르는 모습에 아이가 사탕을 하나 더 줍니다.
success_text_en: Seeing you beg, the kid gives you another one.
fail_text: 달라고 떼를 쓰다 아이에게 핀잔을 듣습니다.
fail_text_en: You throw a tantrum for more and get scolded by the kid.

label: 고개를 젓는다
success_text_en: You refuse the candy, and the kid turns away awkwardly.

label: 노승을 보고 운다
success_text_en: The unfamiliar face makes you burst into tears.
fail_text: 노승이 울음을 달래 주며 한숨을 쉽니다.
fail_text_en: The monk soothes your crying with a sigh.

label: 엄마 뒤로 숨는다
success_text: 엄마 치마 뒤에서 빼꼼 얼굴만 내밉니다.
success_text_en: You peek out from behind Mom's skirt.

label: 노승의 염주를 쥔다
success_text: 염주를 쥐자 노승이 놀란 듯 당신을 오래 바라봅니다.
success_text_en: You grab the beads, and the monk stares at you for a long time, as if startled.
fail_text_en: The string snaps, and the beads scatter.

label: 노승에게 손을 흔든다
success_text: 노승이 빙그레 웃으며 손을 흔들어 줍니다.
success_text_en: The monk smiles gently and waves back.

label: 높이 쌓아 올린다
success_text_en: The blocks rise almost to the ceiling.

label: 무너뜨리며 깔깔 웃는다
success_text_en: The tower crashes down, and you are delighted.
fail_text: 무너진 블록에 발이 찧여 울음이 터집니다.
fail_text_en: A falling block hits your foot, and you burst into tears.

label: 형에게 쌓아 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask your brother to stack them
success_text: 형이 블록을 쌓아 주며 함께 웃습니다.
success_text_en: Your brother stacks the blocks and laughs along with you.
fail_text_en: Your brother is busy and ignores you.

label: 블록을 입에 넣는다
label_en: Put a block in your mouth
success_text_en: You put a block in your mouth, and your mother takes it away.

label: 아무 복권이나 가리킨다
success_text: 가리킨 복권이 웬일인지 맞을 것 같다고 아버지가 떠듭니다.
success_text_en: Your father babbles that the ticket you picked feels like a winner.
fail_text_en: The ticket you picked is a dud.

label: 복권을 찢어 버린다
success_text_en: You tear the ticket, and your father laughs hollowly.

label: 아버지 얼굴을 쓰다듬는다
success_text_en: Your father smiles and hugs you.

label: 복권을 먹으려 한다
success_text: 복권을 입에 넣어 어머니께 혼이 납니다.
success_text_en: You put a ticket in your mouth and your mother scolds you.
fail_text_en: You swallow a scrap of paper and get a tummy ache.

label: 시장 음식 냄새에 침을 흘린다
label_en: Drool at the market food smells
success_text_en: The smell of tteokbokki makes you smack your lips.

label: 상인들에게 손을 흔든다
success_text: 상인들이 귀엽다며 과일을 하나씩 쥐여 줍니다.
success_text_en: The vendors find you adorable and each hand you a piece of fruit.

label: 반짝이는 물건에 손을 뻗는다
success_text: 반짝이는 시계를 쥐려다 어머니에게 야단을 맞습니다.
success_text_en: You reach for a shiny watch and your mother scolds you.
fail_text_en: The vendor frowns and moves the goods away.

label: 엄마 등에서 잠든다
success_text: 어머니 등에 업힌 채 깊이 잠듭니다.
success_text_en: You fall into a deep sleep on your mother's back.

label: 상자 안 금붙이에 손을 뻗는다
label_en: Reach for the gold in the box
success_text: 상자 안 금붙이가 반짝입니다. 어머니의 눈이 휘둥그레집니다.
success_text_en: Gold trinkets glitter in the box. Your mother's eyes go wide.
fail_text_en: The gold turns out to be fake.

label: 상자 자체를 갖고 논다
success_text: 상자 속 빈 공간에 숨는 놀이에 푹 빠집니다.
success_text_en: You become absorbed in hiding inside the empty box.

label: 포장지를 찢으며 즐거워한다
label_en: Tear the wrapping paper with glee
success_text_en: The sound of ripping paper is thrilling.
fail_text_en: You cut your hand on the wrapping paper and burst into tears.

label: 선물은 관심 없고 엄마를 찾는다
label_en: Ignore the gift and look for Mom
success_text: 엄마 품에 안기자 어머니가 웃으며 쓰다듬습니다.
success_text_en: You nestle into Mom's arms, and she strokes you with a smile.

label: 동생을 쓰다듬는다
success_text: 조심조심 동생을 쓰다듬자 어머니가 기특하다고 하십니다.
success_text_en: You gently pet your sibling, and your mother praises you.

label: 엄마를 빼앗긴 것 같아 운다
label_en: Cry because Mom feels taken away
success_text_en: Your crying throws the house into an uproar.
fail_text_en: You keep crying, and your sibling starts crying too.

label: 동생 옆에서 함께 잔다
success_text_en: You lie down beside your sibling and fall asleep.
fail_text_en: You toss and turn and wake your sibling.

label: 동생의 젖병을 빼앗는다
success_text: 젖병을 빼앗아 혼자 물고 있다가 들킵니다.
success_text_en: You steal the bottle and suck on it yourself until you are caught.
fail_text: 젖병을 빼앗다 동생이 울어 크게 혼납니다.
fail_text_en: You grab the bottle, your sibling wails, and you get a serious scolding.

label: 거울을 두드리며 웃는다
success_text: 거울 속 아이가 따라 웃자 신이 납니다.
success_text_en: The child in the mirror laughs back, and you are thrilled.

label: 거울 속 아이에게 말을 건다
label_en: Talk to the child in the mirror
success_text_en: You babble at the mirror.

label: 거울을 핥는다
success_text: 거울에 침이 묻어 어머니가 닦아 주십니다.
success_text_en: You leave drool on the mirror, and your mother wipes it off.

label: 한참 동안 자신을 바라본다
label_en: Stare at yourself for a long time
success_text: 거울 속 얼굴이 유난히 곱다며 모두가 감탄합니다.
success_text_en: Everyone marvels at how lovely the face in the mirror is.
fail_text: 거울 속 얼굴이 낯설어 울음이 터집니다.
fail_text_en: The face in the mirror looks strange, and you burst into tears.

label: 울며 부모를 찾는다
success_text: 울음소리에 부모가 달려와 품에 안아 줍니다.
success_text_en: Your parents rush over at your cries and hold you close.

label: 창밖 번개를 신기하게 바라본다
success_text_en: Your eyes go round at the flashing lightning.
fail_text_en: The lightning frightens you, and you tremble for a long time.

label: 이불을 뒤집어쓴다
label_en: Pull the blanket over your head
success_text_en: You hide from the thunder under the blanket.

label: 천둥소리를 흉내 낸다
success_text: 천둥을 흉내 내 온 집안을 웃음바다로 만듭니다.
success_text_en: Your thunder impression has the whole house in stitches.
fail_text: 흉내를 내다 천둥이 더 크게 울린 것 같아 놀랍니다.
fail_text_en: Mid-impression, the thunder seems to roar louder, and you are startled.

label: 촛불을 후 분다
success_text: 촛불을 후 불자 가족들이 박수를 칩니다.
success_text_en: You blow out the candles, and your family applauds.

label: 케이크에 얼굴을 묻는다
label_en: Bury your face in the cake
success_text: 크림을 얼굴에 묻혀 온 가족이 웃음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: You get frosting all over your face, and the whole family bursts out laughing.
fail_text_en: Frosting gets in your eyes, and you burst into tears.

label: 촛불을 오래 바라본다
label_en: Gaze at the candles for a long time
success_text_en: Your eyes linger on the candle flames.
fail_text_en: The flames flicker, and you burst into tears.

label: 선물부터 뜯는다
success_text_en: You tear open a present and pull out a toy.

label: 먼저 다가가 친구를 사귄다
label_en: Go up and make friends first
success_text: 먼저 말을 건 덕분에 금세 여러 친구가 생깁니다.
success_text_en: Because you spoke first, you quickly make several friends.
fail_text: 말이 통하지 않아 친구들이 다른 곳으로 가 버립니다.
fail_text_en: You can't get through to them, and the other kids wander off.

label: 엄마와 떨어지기 싫어 운다
label_en: Cry, not wanting to leave Mom
success_text: 엄마 치맛자락을 놓지 않아 선생님이 한참을 달랩니다.
success_text_en: You won't let go of Mom's skirt, and the teacher spends ages soothing you.

label: 구석에서 그림책을 읽는다
label_en: Read a picture book in the corner
success_text_en: You quietly turn the pages of a picture book to pass the time.

label: 장난감을 독차지한다
success_text: 장난감을 꽉 쥐고 놓지 않아 친구들이 눈치를 봅니다.
success_text_en: You clutch the toys and won't let go, and the other kids grow wary.
fail_text_en: Your toys get snatched, and the other kids tease you.

label: 선생님을 부른다
success_text_en: The teacher rushes over to check the wound.

label: 손을 잡아 일으켜 준다
label_en: Take their hand and help them up
success_text_en: You help your friend up, and they smile and thank you.
fail_text_en: You pull your friend up and both of you fall.

label: 따라서 운다
success_text_en: You and your friend bawl together.

label: 무릎에 손을 얹고 기도한다
label_en: Lay a hand on the knee and pray
success_text_en: When you finish praying, your friend stops crying.
fail_text: 기도를 외우다 친구가 더 크게 웁니다.
fail_text_en: You recite a prayer, and your friend cries even harder.

label: 갖고 싶은 장난감을 잔뜩 적는다
success_text_en: Your toy list crams the page.
fail_text: 목록이 너무 길어 편지가 다 채워지지 않습니다.
fail_text_en: The list is so long the letter never gets finished.

label: 가족의 건강을 빈다
success_text_en: You write a wish for your family's health, and your mother chokes up.

label: 산타는 없다고 적는다
label_en: Write that there is no Santa
success_text: 산타의 정체를 의심하는 솔직한 편지가 됩니다.
success_text_en: It becomes a frank letter questioning who Santa really is.
fail_text_en: The grown-ups who read it feel a little sad.

label: 산타를 직접 만나게 해 달라고 쓴다
label_en: Ask to meet Santa in person
success_text_en: As you write, you feel a strange thrill.
fail_text_en: You fall asleep in the middle of writing.

label: 귀 기울여 듣는다
success_text_en: Absorbed in the story, you listen to the very end.

label: 질문을 마구 던진다
success_text_en: Your questions are so sharp the teacher has to think for a long time.
fail_text_en: Your questions are so odd the other kids burst out laughing.

label: 졸면서 듣는다
success_text_en: You nod off and wake up at snack time.

label: 간식만 기다린다
success_text_en: Thinking only of snacks, you barely hear the story.
fail_text_en: The teacher reprimands you.

label: 차례를 지킨다
success_text_en: The teacher praises you for waiting your turn.

label: 새치기를 한다
success_text: 앞으로 밀고 들어가 아이들의 원성을 삽니다.
success_text_en: You push to the front and draw the other kids' outrage.
fail_text_en: You get sent to the back of the line.

label: 동생에게 순서를 양보한다
success_text_en: Your sibling slides down happily.
fail_text_en: Your sibling throws a fit and starts crying.

label: 거꾸로 기어 올라간다
success_text_en: The other kids marvel as you scramble up the wrong way.

label: 제일 큰 것을 고른다
success_text_en: You pick a big candy and are thrilled.

label: 동생 것도 고른다
label_en: Pick one for your sibling too
success_text_en: You pick one for your sibling too, and Mom is pleased.
fail_text: 동생이 자기 것도 달라고 떼를 씁니다.
fail_text_en: Your sibling throws a fit demanding theirs.

label: 고르지 않는다
success_text: 아무것도 고르지 않고 엄마 손을 잡고 나옵니다.
success_text_en: You pick nothing and walk out holding Mom's hand.

label: 몰래 하나를 더 챙긴다
success_text_en: You hide the pilfered candy in your pocket.
fail_text_en: You get caught at the register and turn red.

label: 넘어져도 계속 탄다
label_en: Keep riding even when you fall
success_text: 무릎이 까져도 다시 일어서 페달을 밟습니다.
success_text_en: Even with scraped knees, you get back up and pedal on.
fail_text: 넘어진 자리가 쓰라려 한참을 앉아 있습니다.
fail_text_en: The scrape stings, and you sit there for a long time.

label: 보조 바퀴를 떼지 않겠다고 한다
label_en: Refuse to take off the training wheels
success_text: 보조 바퀴를 달고 골목을 한 바퀴 돕니다.
success_text_en: You ride a lap around the alley with training wheels.

label: 금방 혼자 탄다
label_en: Ride on your own right away
success_text: 아빠가 손을 놓자 씽씽 달려 나갑니다. 동네 어른들이 감탄합니다.
success_text_en: Dad lets go, and you zoom off. The neighborhood adults are impressed.
fail_text_en: You lose your balance and crash into a utility pole.

label: 무서워서 그만둔다
success_text_en: Scared of the bike, you cling to Dad.

label: 주인공을 하겠다고 우긴다
success_text: 주인공을 따내 무대에 섭니다. 선생님도 놀랄 만큼 당당합니다.
success_text_en: You land the lead and take the stage, confident enough to surprise even the teacher.
fail_text: 주인공을 못 맡아 무대에서 떼를 씁니다.
fail_text_en: You don't get the lead and throw a fit on stage.

label: 나무 역할을 맡는다
success_text: 나무 옷을 입고 조용히 서 있습니다.
success_text_en: You wear a tree costume and stand quietly.

label: 대본을 모두 외운다
success_text: 대사를 척척 외워 선생님을 놀라게 합니다.
success_text_en: You rattle off your lines and astonish the teacher.
fail_text_en: You keep forgetting your lines.

label: 무대 뒤에서 친구를 돕는다
success_text: 친구 옷매무새를 고쳐 주며 힘을 북돋웁니다.
success_text_en: You straighten a friend's costume and cheer them on.

label: 부러워서 엄마에게 조른다
success_text: 우리 집도 크게 넓혀 달라고 떼를 씁니다.
success_text_en: You throw a tantrum demanding a bigger house.
fail_text_en: Mom sighs, at a loss.

label: 친구와 즐겁게 논다
success_text_en: You run around the yard with your friend.

label: 우리 집이 더 좋다고 생각한다
label_en: Decide your own home is better
success_text_en: Back home, you feel at ease.
fail_text_en: Your house feels small, and you are upset for no reason.

label: 친구 장난감을 몰래 가져온다
success_text: 장난감을 몰래 숨겨 가져오는 데 성공합니다.
success_text_en: You manage to smuggle the toy home.
fail_text: 친구가 울며 엄마에게 말해 들키고 맙니다.
fail_text_en: Your friend tells their mom in tears, and you get caught.

label: 경찰 아저씨에게 가져다준다
label_en: Take it to a police officer
success_text_en: The officer praises you and pats your head.

label: 사탕을 사 먹는다
success_text_en: You buy candy at the corner store.
fail_text: 사탕 가게 주인이 동전이 가짜라며 돌려줍니다.
fail_text_en: The shopkeeper hands the coin back, saying it's fake.

label: 저금통에 넣는다
label_en: Put it in your piggy bank
success_text_en: Your piggy bank grows heavier.

label: 동전을 던져 앞뒤를 맞혀 본다
label_en: Flip the coin and call it
success_text: 앞면이 연거푸 나옵니다. 신기해서 몇 번이고 던집니다.
success_text_en: Heads comes up again and again. Fascinated, you flip it over and over.
fail_text_en: You keep getting tails and end up losing the coin.

label: 끝까지 집중한다
success_text: 한 판을 끝까지 두며 할아버지를 놀라게 합니다.
success_text_en: You play a full game to the end and astonish your grandfather.

label: 지자 바둑판을 엎는다
label_en: Overturn the board when you lose
success_text: 진 것이 분해 바둑돌을 쏟아 버립니다.
success_text_en: Furious at losing, you scatter the stones.
fail_text_en: Your grandfather scolds you.

label: 할아버지 수를 따라 한다
success_text_en: You learn by mimicking your grandfather's moves.

label: 바둑돌로 공기놀이를 한다
success_text_en: You roll the stones around and play quietly.

label: 푹 자고 일어난다
success_text: 잠을 푹 자고 나니 열이 내립니다.
success_text_en: After a good sleep, the fever goes down.

label: 아픈 척을 계속한다
success_text_en: Faking illness gets you a toy.
fail_text_en: Your faking is found out, and you get scolded.

label: 엄마에게 동화책을 읽어 달라 한다
label_en: Ask Mom to read you a storybook
success_text_en: You fall asleep to Mom's voice.
fail_text_en: Mom is too busy to read to you.

label: 창밖을 보며 혼자 이야기를 지어낸다
label_en: Make up stories while looking out the window
success_text: 창밖 나무에 얽힌 이야기를 지어내며 시간을 보냅니다.
success_text_en: You pass the time making up stories about the tree outside.
fail_text_en: Your own story scares you to tears.

label: 사자 우리 앞을 떠나지 않는다
label_en: Refuse to leave the lion enclosure
success_text_en: You can't tear your eyes from the lion's gaze.

label: 토끼에게 먹이를 준다
success_text_en: A rabbit takes the grass from you, and you break into a smile.

label: 솜사탕만 먹는다
success_text_en: Your fingers get sticky with cotton candy.
fail_text: 솜사탕을 너무 많이 먹어 배탈이 납니다.
fail_text_en: You eat too much cotton candy and get a stomachache.

label: 뱀 우리 앞에서 한참을 서 있다
label_en: Stand at the snake enclosure for a long time
success_text: 뱀이 똬리를 튼 모습을 오래 바라봅니다.
success_text_en: You watch the coiled snake for a long time.
fail_text_en: The snake startles you, and you back away.

label: 다시 그린다
success_text: 처음보다 더 정성껏 그려 칭찬을 받습니다.
success_text_en: You draw it with more care than before and earn praise.
fail_text_en: Even redrawn, it's still clumsy.

label: 친구 그림을 찢는다
success_text: 찢어진 그림을 보며 친구가 울음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: Seeing the torn drawing, your friend bursts into tears.
fail_text_en: The teacher scolds you harshly.

label: 선생님께 이른다
success_text_en: The teacher has a word with your friend.

label: 같이 웃어 버린다
success_text_en: You laugh along, and you and your friend quickly make up.
fail_text_en: You become a laughingstock and feel hurt.

label: 신부님을 따라 성호를 긋는다
success_text_en: You make the sign of the cross along with the priest.

label: 지루해서 의자 밑으로 기어간다
label_en: Crawl under the pew out of boredom
success_text: 의자 밑에서 놀다 어머니에게 끌려 나옵니다.
success_text_en: You play under the pew until your mother drags you out.
fail_text_en: The believers stare at you, and your face turns red.

label: 성가대 노래에 넋을 잃는다
success_text_en: Absorbed in the singing, you listen for a long time.
fail_text_en: The singing is so loud it startles you into tears.

label: 헌금 바구니에 손을 넣는다
success_text_en: You pluck a coin from the offering basket.
fail_text: 헌금을 훔친 것이 들통나 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: You are caught stealing from the offering and severely scolded.

label: 꼬박꼬박 적는다
success_text_en: You record your allowance every day and feel proud.

label: 받자마자 다 쓴다
label_en: Spend it all as soon as you get it
success_text_en: You blow your whole allowance at the snack bar.
fail_text_en: Your allowance runs out fast, and you mope.

label: 동생 용돈까지 관리한다
success_text_en: You record your sibling's allowance in the ledger too.
fail_text_en: Your sibling sees the ledger and throws a fit.

label: 잃어버린다
success_text_en: You can't remember where you put the ledger.

label: 거절하고 도망친다
success_text_en: You dash home as fast as you can.

label: 큰 소리로 어른을 부른다
success_text_en: At your shout, the neighborhood adults come running.
fail_text_en: No one comes out, and you burst into tears.

label: 사탕만 받고 달아난다
success_text_en: You take the candy and flee.
fail_text_en: You trip while running and scrape your knee.

label: 왜 그러냐고 따져 묻는다
success_text: 어른에게 따져 묻자 어른이 말문이 막혀 달아납니다.
success_text_en: You confront the adult, who is left speechless and slinks off.
fail_text_en: The adult grows angry and grabs your wrist.

label: 열심히 공을 쫓는다
success_text_en: You end up drenched in sweat from chasing the ball, but it's fun.

label: 골키퍼를 자처한다
success_text_en: You guard the goal and win the big kids' praise.
fail_text_en: The ball hits you, and it stings.

label: 공을 들고 도망간다
success_text_en: You run off with the ball and end up fighting with the big kids.
fail_text_en: The big kids take the ball back and tease you.

label: 응원만 한다
success_text_en: You cheer hard, and the big kids are grateful.

label: 용기 내어 다녀온다
label_en: Work up the courage and go
success_text_en: You summon your courage and go alone.

label: 엄마를 깨운다
success_text_en: Mom follows you with sleepy eyes.
fail_text_en: Mom grumbles and rolls over.

label: 참는다
success_text_en: You hold it in and try to sleep.
fail_text_en: You hold it until you have an accident in bed.

label: 기도를 외우며 간다
label_en: Recite a prayer as you go
success_text_en: You recite a prayer as you pass down the dark hall.
fail_text: 기도를 외우다 그림자에 놀라 울어 버립니다.
fail_text_en: Mid-prayer, a shadow startles you into tears.

label: 얼굴에 그림을 그린다
success_text: 얼굴에 그림을 그리며 놀자 가족이 웃음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: You doodle on your face, and the family bursts out laughing.
fail_text: 얼굴이 엉망이 되어 어머니에게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: Your face is a mess, and your mother scolds you.

label: 엄마에게 가져다준다
success_text_en: You hand Mom the lipstick, and she praises you.

label: 립스틱을 부러뜨린다
success_text_en: The lipstick snaps in two.
fail_text: 엄마가 아끼던 물건이라 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: It was one of Mom's treasures, and you get a severe scolding.

label: 거울 앞에서 꾸미기 놀이를 한다
label_en: Play dress-up in front of the mirror
success_text: 거울 앞에서 한참을 꾸미고 노는 데 빠집니다.
success_text_en: You get lost in primping in front of the mirror.
fail_text_en: You get caught playing dress-up and turn red.

label: 같이 들어 드린다
success_text_en: You and the old woman share the load up the hill.

label: 엄마를 불러온다
success_text: 엄마가 달려와 짐을 함께 들어 줍니다.
success_text_en: Mom hurries over and helps carry the load.
fail_text_en: Mom is busy, and the old woman struggles on alone.

label: 모른 척한다
success_text_en: You walk right past and go home.

label: 수고비를 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask to be paid for it
success_text_en: The old woman fumbles through her pockets, embarrassed.
fail_text_en: The old woman turns away, hurt.

label: 대통령
success_text_en: The other kids say "Wow" in awe.
fail_text_en: The teacher smiles and asks if you have another dream.

label: 의사
success_text: 가족 중에 아픈 사람을 돌보고 싶다고 말합니다.
success_text_en: You say you want to care for the sick people in your family.

label: 부자
success_text: 돈 많은 사람이 되고 싶다고 말합니다.
success_text_en: You say you want to be someone with lots of money.
fail_text_en: Your friends laugh and tease you.

label: 신부님이나 스님
success_text: 신부님이나 스님이 되고 싶다고 말하자 선생님이 놀라 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: You say you want to be a priest or a monk, and the teacher nods in surprise.
fail_text_en: Your friends laugh and call you weird.

label: 정확히 반으로 나눈다
success_text_en: You split them exactly in half, and your sibling thanks you.

label: 큰 쪽을 동생에게 준다
label_en: Give your sibling the bigger half
success_text: 큰 쪽을 준 덕에 동생이 웃습니다.
success_text_en: Your sibling smiles at getting the bigger half.
fail_text_en: Your sibling grumbles at the smaller share.

label: 큰 쪽을 먹는다
success_text_en: You enjoy every bite of the bigger half.
fail_text_en: Your sibling bursts into tears.

label: 다 먹어 버린다
success_text_en: You polish off every last cracker.
fail_text: 동생이 울고 어머니께 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: Your sibling cries, and your mother scolds you severely.

label: 끝까지 아니라고 말한다
success_text_en: You hold out, denying it to the end.
fail_text_en: No one believes you.

label: 울어 버린다
success_text_en: You burst into tears, leaving even the teacher at a loss.

label: 진짜 범인을 찾아낸다
success_text: 친구들의 행동을 살펴 진짜 범인을 찾아냅니다.
success_text_en: You watch the other kids closely and find the real culprit.
fail_text: 범인을 찾지 못해 누명이 더 깊어집니다.
fail_text_en: You fail to find the culprit, and suspicion deepens.

label: 그냥 잘못했다고 한다
success_text_en: Though it's unfair, you just say you did it.

label: 아빠 무릎에 앉아 웃게 해 준다
label_en: Sit on Dad's lap and make him laugh
success_text: 아빠 무릎에 앉아 재롱을 떠니 아빠가 웃음을 되찾습니다.
success_text_en: You sit on Dad's lap and clown around until he laughs again.

label: 갖고 싶은 것을 참는다
label_en: Hold back on what you want
success_text: 갖고 싶은 장난감을 끝내 말하지 않습니다.
success_text_en: You never mention the toy you want.
fail_text_en: Holding back is hard, and you toss and turn all night.

label: 돼지저금통을 아빠에게 준다
success_text_en: You hand your piggy bank to Dad.
fail_text_en: The piggy bank won't break open, and Dad is at a loss.

label: 무슨 일인지 계속 묻는다
success_text_en: You keep asking, and Dad loses his temper.
fail_text_en: Dad shuts himself in his room.

label: 뷔페를 휩쓴다
success_text_en: You pile your plate high at the buffet.

label: 화동을 맡아 꽃을 뿌린다
label_en: Be the flower child and scatter petals
success_text_en: You scatter petals to the guests' applause.
fail_text_en: You trip while scattering petals.

label: 축의금 봉투를 만지작거린다
success_text: 봉투 속 돈이 궁금해 자꾸 만집니다.
success_text_en: Curious about the money inside, you keep fiddling with the envelopes.
fail_text_en: The grown-ups scold you.

label: 성혼 선언문을 따라 외운다
success_text_en: You recite the officiant's words along with him, growing solemn.
fail_text_en: The officiant's long speech bores you into yawning.

label: 맨손으로 잡아 본다
success_text_en: You catch a fish with your bare hands.
fail_text_en: You slip and fall into the water.

label: 잡은 물고기를 놓아준다
success_text_en: You let the fish go, and your friends are impressed.

label: 가장 많이 잡겠다고 경쟁한다
success_text_en: You win the contest and are thrilled.
fail_text_en: You come in last, and your friends tease you.

label: 물에 빠진다
success_text_en: You fall in and flail.
fail_text_en: You are rescued, but badly hurt.

label: 할머니 말을 믿는다
success_text_en: You quietly take her words to heart.
fail_text_en: Her words make you uneasy.

label: 무섭다며 달아난다
success_text_en: You avoid her gaze and hurry off.

label: 할머니 부채를 빼앗아 흉내 낸다
label_en: Grab her fan and imitate her
success_text: 부채를 흔들며 할머니 흉내를 냅니다. 동네 아이들이 웃습니다.
success_text_en: You wave the fan and mimic her. The neighborhood kids laugh.
fail_text_en: You break the fan, and the old woman flies into a rage.

label: 할머니 눈을 똑바로 본다
label_en: Look her straight in the eye
success_text: 할머니의 눈빛이 깊어지고 할머니가 씩 웃으며 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: Her gaze deepens, and she grins and nods.
fail_text_en: Her gaze terrifies you, and you freeze.

label: 간판을 모두 읽고 다닌다
success_text: 간판을 소리 내어 읽으며 신나게 다닙니다.
success_text_en: You read the signs out loud and skip happily along.

label: 받아쓰기를 백 번 연습한다
success_text_en: Your dictation notebook fills up.
fail_text_en: Bored of practicing, you throw the notebook.

label: 그림만 그린다
success_text_en: You get absorbed in drawing.

label: 글자를 거꾸로 쓰며 장난친다
label_en: Write the letters backward as a joke
success_text_en: You laugh at your backward writing.
fail_text_en: The teacher scolds you.

label: 모두를 초대한다
success_text_en: Everyone comes, and the party is a riot.

label: 친한 친구만 부른다
success_text_en: You throw a cozy party with your close friends.
fail_text_en: The other kids feel left out.

label: 선물을 많이 줄 친구만 부른다
label_en: Invite only friends who will bring big gifts
success_text: 선물이 쌓여 기뻐하지만 친구들의 눈빛이 차갑습니다.
success_text_en: The gifts pile up and you are pleased, but your friends' eyes are cold.
fail_text_en: Your friends spread rumors.

label: 파티를 하지 않는다
success_text_en: Your birthday passes quietly.

label: 피해자들을 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You fold your hands in front of the television.

label: 저금통을 털어 성금을 낸다
label_en: Empty your piggy bank for donations
success_text_en: You empty your piggy bank into the donation box.
fail_text_en: You empty your piggy bank, but it holds so little that you feel let down.

label: 무서워서 잠을 못 잔다
success_text_en: You toss and turn all night to the sound of the TV.
fail_text_en: You have nightmares and run a fever.

label: 채널을 돌린다
success_text_en: You switch over to cartoons.

label: 열심히 다닌다
success_text_en: You attend the academy every week without fail.

label: 싫다고 떼를 쓴다
success_text_en: You throw a tantrum and plant yourself outside the academy.
fail_text_en: Your mother sighs and gives up.

label: 태권도를 보내 달라고 한다
success_text_en: You show off a kick in front of the taekwondo studio.
fail_text_en: Your mother refuses, saying taekwondo lessons are too expensive.

label: 피아노 대신 노래를 부른다
success_text_en: Your singing earns your relatives' praise.
fail_text: 노래를 시켜도 목소리가 작아 놀림을 받습니다.
fail_text_en: When asked to sing, your voice is so small you get teased.

label: 솔직히 털어놓는다
success_text: 솔직하게 털어놓자 엄마가 꼭 안아 줍니다.
success_text_en: You come clean, and Mom hugs you tight.

label: 끝까지 우긴다
success_text_en: You stubbornly play innocent to the end.
fail_text_en: Your lie is exposed, and you get a severe scolding.

label: 동생 탓을 한다
success_text_en: You pin it on your sibling.
fail_text_en: Your sibling cries that it isn't fair.

label: 울어서 상황을 넘긴다
label_en: Cry your way out of it
success_text_en: Your tears soften Mom's heart.
fail_text_en: You just stop crying, and Mom grows more suspicious.

label: 직원에게 도움을 청한다
label_en: Ask a staff member for help
success_text: 안내 직원이 방송으로 가족을 찾아 줍니다.
success_text_en: A staff member finds your family over the PA.

label: 제자리에서 기다린다
success_text_en: You stay put, and your mother comes running.
fail_text_en: You tremble with fear as you wait.

label: 혼자 출구를 찾아 나선다
label_en: Look for the exit on your own
success_text_en: You march off bravely in search of the exit.
fail_text_en: After wandering for ages, you collapse from exhaustion.

label: 울면서 엄마를 부른다
success_text_en: Your crying draws a crowd.

label: 전력으로 달린다
success_text_en: You run with all your might and come in first.
fail_text_en: You run out of breath halfway and sink to the ground.

label: 넘어진 친구를 일으키고 함께 뛴다
label_en: Help up a fallen friend and run together
success_text: 넘어진 친구를 일으켜 함께 결승선을 통과합니다.
success_text_en: You help a fallen friend up and cross the finish line together.

label: 지름길로 가로지른다
label_en: Take a shortcut across the field
success_text_en: You cut across and get caught by the teacher.
fail_text_en: You come in last and get teased.

label: 걸어서 들어온다
success_text_en: You stroll slowly across the line.

label: 데려가자고 조른다
success_text: 엄마를 붙잡고 조르지만 쉽게 허락을 받지 못합니다.
success_text_en: You plead with Mom, but she won't easily say yes.
fail_text_en: Mom firmly says no.

label: 먹을 것을 나눠 준다
success_text_en: You share your leftover bread.

label: 무서워서 피한다
success_text_en: The puppy barks, and you back away.
fail_text_en: The puppy chases you, and you run off crying.

label: 강아지를 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You pray for the puppy.
fail_text_en: Praying feels awkward, and your face turns red.

label: 상자를 열어 본다
success_text_en: The box is full of old photographs.

label: 할아버지께 가져간다
success_text_en: Your grandfather tells you stories from the old days.
fail_text_en: Your grandfather takes the box without interest.

label: 상자 속 금화를 꺼내 든다
label_en: Take out the gold coins in the box
success_text: 상자 속에서 금화가 나옵니다. 누군가 숨겨 둔 것 같습니다.
success_text_en: Gold coins turn up in the box. Someone seems to have hidden them.
fail_text_en: What looked like gold coins are fakes.

label: 상자를 보물로 숨긴다
label_en: Hide the box as your treasure
success_text_en: You secretly stash away your treasure box.

label: 끝까지 지킨다
success_text_en: You keep the secret to the end.

label: 다른 친구에게 말해 버린다
success_text_en: Before you know it, the secret has spread through the whole class.
fail_text_en: Your friend resents you.

label: 비밀을 이용해 친구를 부린다
label_en: Use the secret to boss your friend around
success_text_en: Holding the secret over them, you order your friend around.
fail_text_en: Your friend stops coming around.

label: 같이 고민해 준다
success_text_en: You share your friend's worries.
fail_text_en: You listen to their worries but can't solve anything.

label: 잔돈까지 정확히 가져온다
label_en: Bring back every bit of change
success_text_en: You count out every coin of change, and Mom praises you.

label: 잔돈으로 과자를 사 먹는다
success_text_en: You buy snacks with the change.
fail_text_en: The change comes up short, and Mom scolds you.

label: 길을 잃는다
success_text_en: You get lost in the alleys.
fail_text_en: You wander for a long time, crying.

label: 가게 주인과 친해진다
success_text_en: The shopkeeper throws in a free candy.
fail_text_en: The shopkeeper, annoyed, shoos you out.

label: 가방을 미리 싸 놓는다
label_en: Pack your bag ahead of time
success_text_en: You stuff your bag full of school supplies.

label: 학교 가기 싫다고 운다
label_en: Cry that you don't want to go to school
success_text_en: School frightens you, and you burst into tears.
fail_text_en: You cry yourself to sleep.

label: 친구를 많이 사귈 생각에 설렌다
label_en: Get excited about making lots of friends
success_text_en: You thrill at the thought of new friends.
fail_text_en: Your excitement overflows, and you get a little giddy.

label: 반장이 되겠다고 다짐한다
success_text_en: You firmly vow to become class president.
fail_text_en: Your resolve fizzles out.

label: 열심히 준비한다
success_text: 열심히 공부한 덕분에 좋은 점수를 받습니다.
success_text_en: Your hard studying earns you a good score.
fail_text_en: Underprepared, you are tense throughout the test.

label: 짝꿍 답안지를 훔쳐본다
success_text_en: You copy your deskmate's answers and earn points.
fail_text_en: You get caught and called to the teacher.

label: 모르는 문제는 감으로 찍는다
label_en: Guess on the ones you don't know
success_text_en: Most of your guesses turn out right.
fail_text_en: Every one of your guesses is wrong.

label: 시험지에 그림을 그린다
success_text: 시험지 여백에 그림을 그리다 시간이 갑니다.
success_text_en: Time slips away as you doodle in the margins.

label: 출마하여 연설한다
success_text: 또렷한 목소리로 연설해 친구들의 박수를 받습니다.
success_text_en: You speak in a clear voice and win your classmates' applause.
fail_text_en: Nerves get the better of you, and you botch the speech.

label: 친구를 추천한다
success_text_en: You nominate a friend and laugh together.

label: 사탕을 돌려 표를 모은다
success_text_en: You hand out candy to gather votes.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that it was bribery.

label: 관심 없다
success_text_en: Uninterested in the election, you keep a low profile.

label: 끝까지 살아남는다
success_text_en: You dodge well and last to the end.
fail_text_en: The ball hits you, and you are out early.

label: 공을 피하지 않고 잡아 낸다
label_en: Catch the ball instead of dodging
success_text_en: You catch the incoming ball and get your opponent out.
fail_text_en: You miss the catch and hurt your finger.

label: 일부러 맞고 나간다
label_en: Get hit on purpose and go out
success_text_en: You go out early and cheer for your friends.

label: 친구를 방패로 삼는다
label_en: Use a friend as a shield
success_text_en: You hide behind a friend to dodge the ball.
fail_text_en: Your friends resent you and turn their backs.

label: 용돈을 모두 쏟아붓는다
success_text: 용돈을 몽땅 쓰지만 좋은 장난감을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: You spend every coin, but you win a good toy.
fail_text_en: You come home broke.

label: 한 번만 뽑는다
success_text_en: You draw once and are satisfied.

label: 연달아 1등을 뽑는다
label_en: Win first prize again and again
success_text: 연달아 1등이 나와 문방구 주인도 혀를 내두릅니다.
success_text_en: You draw first prize again and again, and even the shop owner is amazed.
fail_text_en: You draw nothing but duds.

label: 친구에게 뽑기를 양보한다
success_text_en: Your friend is thrilled and thanks you.
fail_text_en: Your friend thanks you, but a twinge of regret remains.

label: 무슨 잘못을 했는지 떨며 간다
label_en: Go trembling, wondering what you did wrong
success_text_en: You open the staff room door with a pounding heart.

label: 당당하게 간다
success_text_en: You stride in and talk with the teacher.
fail_text_en: Your confidence comes off as cheeky.

label: 선생님 심부름을 기꺼이 한다
label_en: Gladly run errands for the teacher
success_text_en: You take on errands and win the teacher's trust.
fail_text_en: The errands annoy you, and you grumble.

label: 칭찬받을 일을 기대한다
success_text_en: You are excited, expecting praise.
fail_text_en: Instead of praise, you get a warning.

label: 성경 암송 대회에서 1등을 한다
success_text_en: You win the recitation contest and receive a prize.
fail_text_en: Nerves make you forget the verse.

label: 밤새 기도회에 남는다
label_en: Stay for the all-night prayer meeting
success_text_en: You pray all night and steady your heart.
fail_text_en: You doze off mid-prayer and keel over.

label: 친구들과 몰래 빠져나와 논다
label_en: Sneak out with friends to play
success_text_en: You sneak out and share snacks.
fail_text_en: The teacher catches you, and you are punished.

label: 목사님께 끝없이 질문한다
label_en: Ply the pastor with endless questions
success_text_en: Your questions are so sharp even the pastor is impressed.
fail_text_en: Your questions leave the pastor at a loss.

label: 다른 친구들과 어울린다
success_text: 다른 친구들과 함께 어울리며 소외를 피합니다.
success_text_en: You hang out with other kids and avoid being left out.

label: 정면으로 맞선다
success_text: 당당히 맞서자 친구들이 한 발 물러납니다.
success_text_en: You stand your ground, and they back off.
fail_text_en: Standing up to them turns into a fight, and you get scolded.

label: 혼자 지내는 것도 괜찮다
success_text_en: You spend your time reading alone.
fail_text_en: Loneliness washes over you.

label: 선생님께 도움을 청한다
success_text_en: The teacher calls the kids in and has a word with them.
fail_text_en: The teacher says they are busy and leaves.

label: 게임에 빠진다
success_text_en: You game all night and are late for school.
fail_text_en: Your grades drop because of games.

label: 타자를 배운다
success_text_en: You take a liking to typing practice.
fail_text_en: The practice bores you, and you quit.

label: PC통신으로 세상을 탐험한다
label_en: Explore the world through the PC network
success_text: 전화선으로 PC통신에 접속해 세상 소식을 찾아봅니다.
success_text_en: You dial into the PC network over the phone line and look up news of the world.
fail_text: 전화 요금 고지서가 날아와 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: The phone bill arrives, and you get a severe scolding.

label: 허락된 시간만 쓴다
label_en: Use it only for the allowed time
success_text_en: You use it only for the set time and stop.

label: 마지막 인사를 드린다
success_text_en: You bow before the memorial portrait and say goodbye.

label: 죽음에 대해 오래 생각한다
success_text_en: You think about life and death for a long time.
fail_text_en: Fear keeps you awake.

label: 상갓집 음식을 먹는다
success_text_en: You eat a hearty bowl of the funeral yukgaejang.
fail_text_en: You cry all night and fall ill.

label: 꿈에서 할아버지를 만난다
label_en: Meet your grandfather in a dream
success_text_en: In your dream, your grandfather smiles and waves.
fail_text_en: Even in your dreams, you cannot find your grandfather.

label: 용돈을 모두 쓴다
success_text_en: You buy a limited-edition sticker and show it off.
fail_text_en: You bought an expensive sticker, but it was fake.

label: 딱지를 교환하며 이득을 본다
success_text_en: You trade your way to a rare ttakji.
fail_text_en: Your friends tease you for being a cheapskate.

label: 동생에게 나눠 준다
success_text_en: Your sibling beams with delight.

label: 유행을 따르지 않는다
success_text: 유행에 휩쓸리지 않고 혼자 책을 읽습니다.
success_text_en: Unswayed by the craze, you read books on your own.

label: 진심을 담아 쓴다
success_text: 자기 이야기를 담은 글로 칭찬을 받습니다.
success_text_en: Your piece about your own life earns praise.
fail_text_en: Your feelings are too heavy, and the writing falls apart.

label: 어른스러운 표현을 흉내 낸다
success_text_en: Your stylish phrasing catches the judges' attention.
fail_text_en: Your awkward phrasing costs you points.

label: 책에서 베낀다
success_text_en: Your copying is found out, and you are disqualified.
fail_text_en: Rumors of plagiarism spread through the school.

label: 신에 대한 글을 쓴다
success_text: 신에 대한 글이 심사위원의 마음을 움직입니다.
success_text_en: Your piece about God moves the judges.
fail_text_en: It is judged too religious and scores poorly.

label: 끝까지 헤엄친다
success_text_en: You swim all the way across the lane.
fail_text_en: Out of breath, you swallow a lot of water.

label: 튜브를 놓지 않는다
label_en: Don't let go of the float
success_text: 튜브를 꼭 잡고 조심스럽게 떠 있습니다.
success_text_en: You cling to the float and stay carefully afloat.

label: 물에 빠질 뻔하다 구조된다
success_text_en: A lifeguard barely manages to save you.
fail_text_en: The rescue comes late, and you get a terrible scare.

label: 다이빙대에서 뛰어내린다
success_text_en: You leap gracefully off the diving board, and your friends cheer.
fail_text_en: You belly-flop and get badly hurt.

label: 그냥 지나친다
success_text_en: You walk past as if nothing happened.

label: 몰래 가져간다
success_text_en: You slip the bill into your pocket.
fail_text_en: Mom notices right away and scolds you severely.

label: 엄마에게 지갑이 열렸다고 알린다
label_en: Tell Mom her wallet is open
success_text_en: Mom thanks you and strokes your head.

label: 가져갔다가 다시 돌려놓는다
label_en: Take it, then put it back
success_text_en: Your heart pounds, but you put it back.
fail_text_en: Mom catches you putting it back.

label: 먼저 말을 건다
success_text_en: You speak first and quickly become friends.

label: 전학생 소문을 퍼뜨린다
label_en: Spread rumors about the transfer student
success_text_en: You gossip about the transfer student's family.
fail_text_en: The rumors spread, and you get called to the teacher.

label: 조용히 지켜본다
success_text_en: You quietly observe from a distance.

label: 전학생을 부하로 삼는다
label_en: Make the transfer student your sidekick
success_text_en: The transfer student tags along at your heels.
fail_text_en: The transfer student avoids you.

label: 개미집을 한 달 동안 관찰한다
label_en: Observe an anthill for a month
success_text: 개미집을 한 달 동안 관찰해 그림과 기록을 남깁니다.
success_text_en: You observe an anthill for a month, leaving drawings and notes.
fail_text_en: You get bored partway and stop observing.

label: 백과사전을 베낀다
success_text: 집에 있는 백과사전을 그대로 베껴 씁니다.
success_text_en: You copy straight out of the encyclopedia at home.
fail_text_en: The teacher notices it was copied.

label: 부모님이 대신 해 준다
success_text_en: Your parents help you finish the homework.

label: 밤하늘 별자리를 그린다
success_text_en: You draw the night sky's constellations and earn praise.
fail_text: 흐린 날이 계속되어 그릴 수 없습니다.
fail_text_en: Cloudy days drag on, and you can't draw them.

label: 단호히 거절한다
success_text_en: You refuse firmly and walk away.

label: 호기심에 한 모금 해 본다
label_en: Take a puff out of curiosity
success_text: 한 모금 빨았다가 기침을 심하게 합니다.
success_text_en: You take a drag and cough violently.
fail_text_en: You can't stop coughing and suffer for it.

label: 어른에게 알린다
success_text_en: The grown-ups give the older kid a talking-to.
fail_text_en: The older kid calls you a snitch.

label: 형을 설득한다
success_text_en: The older kid backs off, a little sheepish.
fail_text_en: The older kid gets angry and storms off.

label: 용돈을 털어 좋은 선물을 산다
label_en: Empty your allowance for a nice gift
success_text_en: Your friend is touched by the nice gift.
fail_text_en: Your friend's face falls a little.

label: 직접 만든 선물을 준다
success_text_en: Your friend is touched by the care you put into it.

label: 집에 있던 물건을 포장한다
success_text_en: You wrap up something lying around the house.
fail_text_en: Your friend catches on and is disappointed.

label: 선물 없이 축하만 한다
success_text_en: You offer only your congratulations.

label: 역전승을 거둔다
success_text_en: You sprint with everything at the end and snatch the win.
fail_text_en: You fail to close the gap, and regret fills you.

label: 바통을 떨어뜨린다
success_text_en: You drop the baton, and the cheers turn to groans.
fail_text_en: You trip trying to pick up the baton.

label: 넘어졌지만 끝까지 달린다
label_en: Fall but run to the end
success_text_en: You fall, get back up, and run to the finish.
fail_text_en: You scrape your knee and can't get up for a long time.

label: 일부러 천천히 달려 친구를 돋보이게 한다
label_en: Run slowly on purpose so a friend can shine
success_text_en: Your friend pulls ahead to cheers.

label: 그 사람의 말을 받아 적는다
success_text: 꿈에서 들은 말을 공책에 적어 둡니다.
success_text_en: You jot the words from your dream in a notebook.

label: 무서워서 깨어난다
success_text_en: You wake in a cold sweat.
fail_text_en: You tremble with fear for a while.

label: 그 사람에게 소원을 빈다
success_text_en: You make a wish, and your heart feels at ease.
fail_text_en: You worry your wish won't come true.

label: 그 사람의 손을 잡는다
success_text_en: You take their hand, and a warm light spreads.
fail_text_en: Their hand is ice cold, and you wake with a start.

label: 넓은 방에 기뻐한다
success_text_en: You run around your big new room in glee.

label: 옛 친구들과 헤어져 슬프다
label_en: Be sad to leave your old friends
success_text_en: You are sad to part with your old neighborhood friends.
fail_text_en: Your old friends drift away, and you feel lonely.

label: 새 친구들에게 자랑한다
label_en: Show off to your new friends
success_text_en: Your new friends are envious.
fail_text_en: You brag too much and earn their resentment.

label: 아빠의 사업을 배우고 싶다고 한다
label_en: Say you want to learn Dad's business
success_text: 아빠가 흡족하게 웃으며 사업 이야기를 들려줍니다.
success_text_en: Dad smiles with satisfaction and tells you about his business.
fail_text_en: Dad cuts you off, saying it's too early.

label: 끝까지 붙잡고 푼다
label_en: Stick with it to the end
success_text_en: You stick with it and find the answer.
fail_text_en: Time runs out.

label: 쉬운 문제만 푼다
success_text_en: You breeze through the easy problems.

label: 출제 오류를 찾아 항의한다
label_en: Find an error in the questions and protest
success_text: 출제 오류를 찾아내 심사위원을 놀라게 합니다.
success_text_en: You spot an error in the questions and astonish the judges.
fail_text_en: You are warned for a pointless protest.

label: 포기하고 잔다
success_text_en: You close the test booklet and fall asleep.

label: 밤새 수다를 떤다
success_text_en: You talk the night away.

label: 집이 그리워 운다
success_text_en: Thinking of home, you burst into tears.
fail_text_en: You embarrass yourself in front of your friend's parents.

label: 친구 부모님께 예의 바르게 군다
label_en: Be polite to your friend's parents
success_text: 예의 바른 모습에 친구 부모님이 칭찬하십니다.
success_text_en: Your friend's parents praise your good manners.

label: 친구 집 냉장고를 턴다
success_text_en: You sneak into the fridge and help yourself to snacks.
fail_text: 들켜서 친구 부모님께 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: You are caught, and your friend's parents scold you severely.

label: 가진 돈을 모두 준다
success_text_en: You hand over every coin you have.
fail_text_en: You feel ashamed of yourself for hesitating to hand it over.

label: 빵을 사다 준다
success_text_en: You buy some bread and hand it to him.

label: 외면한다
success_text_en: You look away and walk past.
fail_text_en: Guilt at looking away washes over you.

label: 노숙인을 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You quietly pray for the homeless man.
fail_text_en: Your heart grows heavy as you pray.

label: 특혜를 거절한다
success_text: 특혜를 거절하자 친구들이 당신을 다시 봅니다.
success_text_en: You refuse the special treatment, and your classmates see you in a new light.

label: 마음껏 누린다
success_text_en: You coast comfortably with the teacher behind you.
fail_text_en: Your classmates' resentment grows.

label: 친구들에게 혜택을 나눈다
label_en: Share the perks with your friends
success_text_en: You share the perks, and the class mood improves.
fail_text_en: You share the perks, but some resentment lingers.

label: 선생님을 등에 업고 반을 휘어잡는다
label_en: Rule the class with the teacher behind you
success_text_en: You order your classmates around and throw your weight around.
fail_text_en: Your classmates push back, and the class is in uproar.

label: 지도를 보며 정확히 찾아간다
success_text_en: You follow the map straight to your destination.

label: 종점까지 가 버린다
success_text_en: You zone out and ride all the way to the last stop.
fail_text_en: You get lost and are on the verge of tears.

label: 옆자리 할머니와 친해진다
label_en: Befriend the old lady in the next seat
success_text: 할머니가 과자를 나눠 주며 말벗이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The old lady shares her snacks and keeps you company.

label: 몰래 무임승차를 한다
success_text: 기사 아저씨의 눈을 피해 회수권을 내지 않습니다.
success_text_en: You dodge the driver's eye and skip handing over your token.
fail_text: 기사 아저씨에게 들켜 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: The driver catches you and scolds you severely.

label: 실감 나게 연기한다
success_text: 실감 나는 연기에 객석이 숨을 죽입니다.
success_text_en: Your convincing performance leaves the audience breathless.
fail_text_en: Your stiff acting draws laughter.

label: 대사를 잊는다
success_text_en: You forget your lines, and the play grinds to a halt.
fail_text_en: A friend picks up your lines for you.

label: 악역에도 사연이 있다고 해석한다
label_en: Play the villain as someone with a story
success_text_en: Your nuanced performance earns praise.
fail_text_en: You overthink it, and it clashes with the direction.

label: 주인공 역을 빼앗으려 한다
label_en: Try to steal the lead role
success_text: 주인공의 자리를 노리며 친구에게 시비를 겁니다.
success_text_en: Eyeing the lead, you pick a fight with your friend.
fail_text_en: Your friends turn their backs on you.

label: 우유를 매일 마신다
success_text_en: You drink your milk faithfully.

label: 신경 쓰지 않는다
success_text_en: You figure being tall is all that matters.
fail_text_en: It keeps bothering you.

label: 놀림받자 주먹을 휘두른다
success_text_en: You swing your fists, and the teasing dies down.
fail_text: 선생님께 불려 가 크게 혼이 납니다.
fail_text_en: You get called to the teacher and scolded hard.

label: 몸이 자주 아파 결석한다
success_text_en: Your weak body keeps you absent more and more.
fail_text_en: The absences pile up and your grades slip.

label: 보여 준다
success_text_en: Your friend is delighted and scores points.
fail_text_en: You get caught, and you're both punished.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You refuse firmly.

label: 시험 후에 따로 가르쳐 준다
success_text: 시험이 끝난 뒤 친구에게 풀이를 알려 줍니다.
success_text_en: After the exam, you walk your friend through the answers.
fail_text_en: After the exam, your friend still doesn't get it.

label: 대가를 받고 보여 준다
success_text_en: You get snacks as payment.
fail_text_en: Word gets around, and the class shuns you.

label: 기꺼이 들어간다
success_text_en: You throw yourself into serving at the altar.
fail_text_en: Altar service is hard, and you start complaining.

label: 주말에 놀고 싶어 거절한다
label_en: Refuse, wanting to play on weekends
success_text_en: You spend your weekends freely.

label: 친구와 함께라면 하겠다고 한다
label_en: Say you'll join if a friend does
success_text_en: You join the altar servers with a friend.
fail_text_en: Your friend never joins, and you're left alone.

label: 신부님의 일을 자세히 묻는다
label_en: Ask the priest about his work
success_text_en: Impressed, the priest teaches you in detail.
fail_text_en: You ask so many questions the priest grows flustered.

label: 범인을 추리해 낸다
success_text_en: Careful deduction reveals where the culprit went.
fail_text_en: Your deduction misfires, and you suspect the wrong kid.

label: 의심받는 친구를 감싼다
success_text_en: You stand up for a friend unfairly suspected.
fail_text_en: Your friend is still suspected.

label: 내 돈이 아니니 무관심하다
success_text_en: You decide it's someone else's problem.

label: 범인이 누구든 용서하자고 한다
success_text_en: You talk everyone down and calm them.
fail_text_en: The kids sneer at forgiveness.

label: 하루 종일 수영한다
success_text: 하루 종일 물놀이를 하며 기운을 냅니다.
success_text_en: You splash in the water all day and come back full of energy.

label: 조개껍데기를 모은다
success_text_en: You fill a box to the brim with seashells.
fail_text_en: You get bored and quit quickly.

label: 해산물을 잔뜩 먹는다
success_text_en: You gorge on raw fish and grilled clams.
fail_text_en: You suffer an upset stomach.

label: 해 질 녘 바다를 보며 생각에 잠긴다
label_en: Watch the sea at sunset, lost in thought
success_text_en: The red glow of sunset calms your heart.
fail_text_en: The wind is cold, and you catch a cold.

label: 묵묵히 다닌다
success_text_en: You attend the cram school without complaint.

label: 땡땡이를 친다
success_text_en: You skip cram school and go to the arcade.
fail_text_en: You're caught skipping and get a harsh scolding.

label: 성적으로 증명하겠다며 거절한다
label_en: Refuse, vowing to prove it with grades
success_text_en: You hold out, vowing to prove yourself with grades.
fail_text_en: Your grades don't improve, and you lose heart.

label: 학원비로 다른 걸 사 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask them to spend the tuition on something else
success_text_en: You take the tuition money and buy something else.
fail_text_en: You disappoint your parents.

label: 함께 묻어 준다
success_text_en: You help cover it with soil.

label: 햄스터를 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You say a short prayer for the hamster.
fail_text: 기도가 어색해 친구가 더 울어 버립니다.
fail_text_en: Your prayer is so awkward your friend cries even harder.

label: 새 햄스터를 사라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to buy a new hamster
success_text_en: You suggest getting a new hamster.
fail_text_en: Your friend resents you.

label: 죽음이 무엇인지 묻는다
success_text_en: You talk seriously about death.
fail_text_en: Your friend sinks into deeper grief.

label: 바로 입단한다
success_text_en: You join immediately and become the team's ace.
fail_text_en: Practice is grueling, and you live soaked in sweat.

label: 공부가 먼저라며 거절한다
success_text_en: You decide to focus on your studies.

label: 부모님과 상의한다
label_en: Talk it over with your parents
success_text_en: You join with your parents' permission.
fail_text_en: Your parents object, and you swallow your disappointment.

label: 입단 테스트에서 압도적인 실력을 보인다
success_text_en: Your overwhelming skill stuns the coach.
fail_text_en: Nerves get the better of you, and you can't show your skill.

label: 손편지를 쓴다
success_text_en: Your heartfelt letter moves your parents.

label: 용돈으로 꽃을 산다
success_text_en: You hand over a bouquet with a smile.
fail_text: 용돈이 모자라 꽃 한 송이만 삽니다.
fail_text_en: Your allowance falls short, so you buy just one flower.

label: 깜빡 잊는다
success_text_en: You completely forget their anniversary.
fail_text_en: Your parents are hurt.

label: 동생과 깜짝 파티를 준비한다
label_en: Plan a surprise party with your sibling
success_text_en: You throw a small party with your sibling.
fail_text_en: The party is so shoddy it becomes a joke.

label: 조용히 차를 음미한다
success_text_en: Savoring the tea's aroma, your mind settles.

label: 스님에게 깨달음을 묻는다
success_text_en: The monk answers with a brief teaching.
fail_text_en: The monk only smiles and doesn't answer.

label: 다과만 먹는다
success_text_en: You enjoy the tea snacks.
fail_text_en: The snacks are too sweet and upset your stomach.

label: 차가 써서 얼굴을 찡그린다
success_text_en: The tea is bitter, and you grimace.

label: 편지를 쓴다
success_text_en: You deliver a carefully written letter.
fail_text_en: The letter becomes gossip across the whole class.

label: 몰래 지켜보기만 한다
success_text_en: Watching in silence, your feelings grow.

label: 친구에게 대신 고백해 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask a friend to confess for you
success_text_en: Your friend gladly passes it on.
fail_text_en: Your friend spreads it around as a joke.

label: 공부에 집중하기로 한다
success_text_en: You steel yourself and bury yourself in study.

label: 상대를 논리로 압도한다
success_text_en: Your airtight argument wins over the judges.
fail_text_en: Your logic tangles, and you're left speechless.

label: 상대 의견을 존중한다
success_text: 상대 의견을 존중하자 청중이 박수를 보냅니다.
success_text_en: You respect your opponent's view, and the audience applauds.
fail_text_en: Too much respect saps your argument.

label: 말문이 막힌다
success_text_en: You lose your words and step down.

label: 감정에 호소한다
success_text_en: Your emotional words choke up the audience.
fail_text_en: Emotion runs ahead, and you lose persuasiveness.

label: 경찰에 신고한다
success_text_en: You report it at the police box and leave the case to them.

label: 무서워 숨는다
success_text_en: You hide in the wardrobe, trembling.
fail_text_en: You run into the thief and get a terrible fright.

label: 도둑을 쫓아간다
success_text_en: You chase the thief into an alley and give them a scare.
fail_text_en: You fall and get badly hurt.

label: 잃어버린 물건을 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You pray for the lost belongings.
fail_text_en: Praying only makes you more frustrated.

label: 혼자 다 먹는다
success_text_en: You eat sausages alone until you're full.
fail_text_en: Your friends call you greedy.

label: 친구에게 양보한다
success_text_en: Your friend smiles gratefully.

label: 친구 도시락까지 빼앗아 먹는다
success_text_en: You devour your friend's side dishes too.
fail_text_en: Your friend cries and tells the teacher.

label: 적당히 먹는다
success_text_en: You eat a moderate amount and share with your friends.

label: 귀 기울여 배운다
success_text_en: You take notes on your dad's stories and learn.

label: 용돈으로 투자해 보고 싶다고 한다
success_text: 용돈으로 주식을 사 봅니다. 오르내림이 짜릿합니다.
success_text_en: You buy stocks with your allowance. The ups and downs are thrilling.
fail_text_en: The stock drops, and you lose your allowance.

label: 돈 얘기는 지루하다
success_text_en: Talk of money doesn't interest you.

label: 크게 될 아이라는 말을 듣는다
success_text_en: Your dad marvels that you'll go far.
fail_text: 그 말이 부담이 되어 어깨가 무거워집니다.
fail_text_en: The words weigh on you, and your shoulders grow heavy.

label: 괴롭히는 아이에게 맞선다
success_text_en: You stand your ground and stop the bullying.
fail_text_en: You lose the fight and get hurt.

label: 선생님께 알린다
success_text_en: The teacher steps in and stops the bullying.
fail_text_en: The bullying gets worse behind the teacher's back.

label: 괴롭힘당하는 친구와 함께 다닌다
success_text_en: You go everywhere with your friend.

label: 못 본 척한다
success_text_en: You walk past, pretending not to see.
fail_text_en: The guilt lingers for a long time.

label: 매주 다섯 권씩 빌린다
success_text: 매주 다섯 권씩 책을 빌려 읽습니다.
success_text_en: You borrow and read five books every week.

label: 만화책만 본다
success_text_en: You pick nothing but comics.
fail_text_en: Hooked on comics, you neglect your studies.

label: 종교 서적 코너를 기웃거린다
success_text_en: You open a scripture you've never seen before.
fail_text_en: The difficult words give you a headache.

label: 책을 반납하지 않는다
success_text_en: You keep the books instead of returning them.
fail_text_en: Overdue notices start arriving.

label: 금방 회복한다
success_text_en: You bounce back in a day or two.

label: 일주일 넘게 앓는다
label_en: Stay sick for over a week
success_text_en: You're drained for more than a week.
fail_text_en: Your symptoms worsen, and you're hospitalized.

label: 앓는 동안 이상한 꿈을 꾼다
success_text_en: In a dream, you see an unfamiliar light.
fail_text_en: The dream frightens you, and you sleep poorly.

label: 아픈 친구들을 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You pray for your sick friends.
fail_text_en: Praying drains you even more.

label: 용돈을 모두 저금한다
success_text_en: You save your entire allowance.
fail_text_en: You have less money to save than you'd like.

label: 저금 대신 군것질을 한다
success_text_en: You spend your allowance on snacks.

label: 친구에게 돈을 빌려 저금한다
label_en: Borrow from a friend to save
success_text_en: You join the savings drive with borrowed money.
fail_text_en: You can't pay it back, and things get awkward.

label: 저금왕 상을 받는다
success_text: 저금왕 상을 받아 교실 칭찬을 독차지합니다.
success_text_en: You win Top Saver and soak up all the class's praise.
fail_text_en: Your savings are too small to win anything.

label: 연락처를 꼭 받아 둔다
label_en: Make sure to get their address
success_text: 연락처를 적어 두고 다음 편지를 기다립니다.
success_text_en: You write down the address and wait for the next letter.

label: 울며 붙잡는다
success_text_en: You cling to them, crying, in front of the moving truck.
fail_text: 친구도 함께 울며 이별이 더 아파집니다.
fail_text_en: Your friend cries too, and the goodbye hurts even more.

label: 쿨하게 보낸다
success_text_en: You smile and wave goodbye.
fail_text_en: You act cool, but you feel hollow inside.

label: 가장 아끼는 물건을 선물한다
success_text_en: You hand over a treasured possession.
fail_text_en: You give the gift, but your friend feels burdened by it.

label: 갖고 싶은 것을 말하지 않기로 한다
label_en: Decide not to ask for what you want
success_text_en: You hold it in and say nothing.

label: 돈을 벌 방법을 궁리한다
label_en: Think of ways to make money
success_text_en: You consider jobs like delivering newspapers.
fail_text_en: All that scheming just wears you out.

label: 부모님께 힘내라고 말한다
label_en: Tell your parents to stay strong
success_text_en: Your parents smile and thank you.
fail_text_en: Your parents' sighs grow deeper.

label: 모른 척한다
success_text_en: You pretend not to know and try to sleep.

label: 더 연습해 다음 대회를 준비한다
label_en: Practice more for the next contest
success_text_en: You paint day and night for the next contest.
fail_text_en: Practice bores you, and you put down the brush.

label: 자랑하고 다닌다
success_text_en: You go around showing off your certificate.
fail_text_en: You brag too much, and your friends turn their backs.

label: 상장을 엄마에게 바친다
success_text_en: Mom is overjoyed with the certificate.

label: 상금으로 맛있는 것을 산다
label_en: Buy something tasty with the prize money
success_text_en: You treat your family to something tasty with the prize money.
fail_text_en: The prize money is less than you expected.

label: 먼저 사과한다
success_text_en: You apologize first and make up.

label: 상대가 사과할 때까지 기다린다
success_text_en: After waiting, they come to you first.
fail_text_en: You never get an apology.

label: 다른 친구들을 내 편으로 만든다
success_text_en: You take sides and isolate your friend.
fail_text_en: The whole class thinks badly of you.

label: 다신 안 볼 거라 다짐한다
label_en: Vow never to see them again
success_text_en: You shut your heart tight.
fail_text_en: Your heart is heavy, and you sleep poorly.

label: 조상의 업적을 자랑스러워한다
label_en: Take pride in your ancestors' deeds
success_text_en: Recalling your ancestors' deeds, you feel proud.

label: 이야기 속 신비한 힘을 믿는다
label_en: Believe in the mysterious power in the tales
success_text_en: You come to believe in mysterious powers.
fail_text_en: You worry it's just superstition.

label: 미신이라고 말한다
success_text_en: You laugh off Grandma's stories.
fail_text_en: Grandma is hurt.

label: 숨겨진 땅문서 이야기에 귀를 기울인다
label_en: Listen to the tale of the hidden land deed
success_text: 할머니가 장롱 깊은 곳의 땅문서를 보여 주십니다.
success_text_en: Grandma shows you a land deed tucked deep in the wardrobe.
fail_text_en: The land deed story is just an old tale.

label: 무대에 자원해 올라간다
success_text_en: You go on stage and become the magician's assistant.
fail_text_en: You freeze on stage and come back down.

label: 트릭을 간파해 낸다
success_text_en: You figure out the magic trick.
fail_text_en: You miss the trick, and the magician moves on with a smile.

label: 마술을 따라 연습한다
success_text_en: You practice card tricks with your friends.
fail_text_en: The practice bores you, and you quit.

label: 진짜 마법이라 믿는다
success_text_en: The magician's touch stirs something in you.

label: 1등으로 들어온다
success_text_en: You push to the end and finish first.
fail_text_en: You run out of breath midway and fall behind.

label: 꾀병을 부린다
success_text_en: You fake illness and drop out.
fail_text_en: Your faking is exposed, and you're scolded hard.

label: 완주만 목표로 한다
success_text_en: You run steadily and finish.

label: 숨이 차 쓰러진다
success_text_en: You collapse, gasping for air.
fail_text_en: You collapse and are carried to the nurse's office.

label: 새벽 공기 속에서 마음이 맑아진다
label_en: Feel your mind clear in the dawn air
success_text_en: The dawn air clears your mind.

label: 졸다가 돌아온다
success_text_en: You doze off and come back.
fail_text_en: You couldn't focus on prayer, and it nags at you.

label: 기도 중 몸이 뜨거워진다
label_en: Feel your body burn during prayer
success_text: 기도 중 몸이 뜨거워지고 눈물이 흐릅니다.
success_text_en: Your body burns during prayer, and tears flow.
fail_text_en: Your body trembles, and you nearly collapse.

label: 그 후로 매주 나간다
success_text: 그 후로 매주 새벽 기도에 나갑니다.
success_text_en: After that, you attend dawn prayer every week.
fail_text: 새벽잠 때문에 얼마 못 가 그만둡니다.
fail_text_en: You can't give up sleeping in, so you quit before long.

label: 상장을 받는다
success_text_en: Your name is called, and you receive an award.
fail_text_en: There's no award for you, and you graduate quietly.

label: 담임 선생님께 감사 편지를 드린다
label_en: Give your homeroom teacher a thank-you letter
success_text_en: Your teacher reads the letter and sheds tears.

label: 친구들과 밀가루를 뿌리며 논다
success_text_en: You laugh as you throw flour with your friends.
fail_text_en: Flour gets in your eyes, and you burst into tears.

label: 중학교가 걱정된다
success_text_en: You're anxious about your next school.

label: 두 분을 화해시키려 애쓴다
success_text_en: You try to mediate between them.
fail_text: 두 분 사이에서 오히려 상처를 받습니다.
fail_text_en: Caught between them, you're the one who gets hurt.

label: 매일 밤 가족을 위해 기도한다
label_en: Pray for your family every night
success_text_en: You pray for your family every night.
fail_text_en: Even prayer doesn't ease your anxiety.

label: 아무렇지 않은 척한다
success_text_en: You smile as if nothing's wrong.
fail_text_en: Bottling it up makes you sick.

label: 집 밖으로 나도는 일이 많아진다
label_en: Spend more time away from home
success_text_en: You kill time wandering outside the house.

label: 당당하게 교실에 들어간다
success_text_en: Your confident stride draws your classmates' eyes.
fail_text_en: You try too hard and look awkward.

label: 조용히 뒷자리에 앉는다
success_text_en: You sit quietly and listen to the lesson.

label: 노는 아이들과 어울린다
label_en: Hang out with the rowdy kids
success_text_en: You fall in with the rowdy crowd.
fail_text_en: You can't fit in with the group and end up alone.

label: 첫날부터 공부 계획을 세운다
label_en: Make a study plan from day one
success_text_en: From day one, you write a schedule in your notebook.
fail_text_en: The schedule is too tight, and you give up.

label: 운동으로 푼다
success_text_en: You run laps on the field and sweat out your anger.

label: 부모님께 반항한다
success_text_en: You slam the door and talk back.
fail_text_en: Your parents give you a harsh scolding.

label: 일기를 쓴다
success_text_en: You pour your heart into your diary.
fail_text_en: Your diary falls into your parents' hands.

label: 방에 틀어박힌다
success_text_en: You don't come out of your room.

label: 꼼꼼히 관리한다
success_text_en: You wash and tend your face carefully.
fail_text_en: You do it wrong, and your skin gets worse.

label: 신경 쓰지 않는다
success_text_en: You avoid mirrors and stop caring.

label: 짜다가 덧난다
label_en: Pop them and make it worse
success_text_en: Popping your pimples leaves scars.
fail_text_en: The inflammation spreads, and you see a doctor.

label: 관리 끝에 피부가 몰라보게 좋아진다
label_en: Your skin clears up remarkably with care
success_text: 꾸준한 관리 끝에 피부가 맑아져 친구들이 놀랍니다.
success_text_en: Steady care clears your skin, and your friends are amazed.
fail_text_en: Nothing works, and your confidence drops.

label: 밤새워 공부한다
success_text_en: You study all night and earn good grades.
fail_text_en: You can't fight off sleep and make mistakes on the test.

label: 평소처럼 준비한다
success_text_en: You prepare calmly, as usual.

label: 커닝 페이퍼를 만든다
success_text_en: You make a tiny note and hide it.
fail_text_en: The note is found, and you face suspension.

label: 시험 따위 무의미하다며 논다
success_text_en: You go out and play with your friends.
fail_text_en: Your scores drop, and home turns into a battlefield.

label: 기쁘게 받아 준다
success_text_en: You gladly agree to go out with them.
fail_text_en: Hurt, they turn away.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline politely.

label: 친구들에게 소문낸다
success_text_en: You spread the news among your friends.
fail_text_en: The rumor spreads, and the one who confessed is miserable.

label: 마음 한편에 다른 얼굴이 떠오른다
success_text_en: Another face surfaces in a corner of your heart.
fail_text_en: Your feelings are tangled, and you sleep poorly.

label: 보컬을 맡는다
success_text: 무대에 올라 노래를 부르며 환호를 받습니다.
success_text_en: You sing on stage and the crowd cheers.
fail_text_en: Your voice shakes, and you botch the song.

label: 드럼을 맡아 연습한다
label_en: Take up the drums and practice
success_text_en: You drum every day, drenched in sweat.
fail_text_en: Your hands sting from drum practice.

label: 공연 기획을 맡는다
success_text_en: You set the lineup and lead everyone.

label: 거절하고 관객이 된다
success_text_en: You quietly watch the show from the audience.

label: 마셔 본다
success_text_en: You grimace at the bitterness and sip a little.
fail_text_en: Your stomach churns, and you collapse.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You refuse firmly.

label: 선생님께 알린다
success_text_en: The teacher steps in and talks sense into your friend.
fail_text_en: Your friend calls you a snitch.

label: 위험하다고 친구를 말린다
success_text_en: Your friend puts the bottle down.
fail_text_en: Your friend won't listen and walks off.

label: 찬양 시간에 눈물을 흘린다
success_text_en: Tears flow during the worship songs.

label: 밤에 몰래 빠져나와 논다
label_en: Sneak out at night to play
success_text_en: You sneak out and play with your friends.
fail_text_en: You get caught and scolded by the teacher.

label: 조장을 맡아 아이들을 이끈다
success_text_en: You look after the kids and show leadership.
fail_text_en: Being captain is too much, and you wear out.

label: 목사님의 설교를 반박해 본다
success_text_en: Your logical rebuttal leaves even the pastor pondering.
fail_text_en: You're scolded for being rude.

label: 워크맨을 산다
success_text_en: You listen to music on your Walkman and hang out with friends.
fail_text: 돈이 모자라 반만 살 수 있습니다.
fail_text_en: You're short on money and can only afford half.

label: 책을 잔뜩 산다
success_text: 책을 골라 한 아름 사 옵니다.
success_text_en: You pick out an armful of books and bring them home.

label: 부모님 선물을 산다
success_text_en: You choose gifts for your parents.
fail_text_en: The gifts are modest, and that bothers you.

label: 중고 물건을 사고팔아 돈을 불린다
success_text_en: You resell items at the flea market.
fail_text: 사 온 물건이 고장 나 손해를 봅니다.
fail_text_en: What you bought turns out broken, and you take a loss.

label: 순순히 준다
success_text_en: You hand over the money without a word.

label: 맞서 싸운다
success_text_en: You throw a punch and drive the thug off.
fail_text_en: You take a beating and can't get up for a while.

label: 말로 불량배를 설득한다
success_text_en: You talk the thug into leaving.
fail_text_en: The thug only gets angrier.

label: 선생님께 알린다
success_text_en: The teacher summons the thug.
fail_text_en: The thug promises revenge.

label: 의사가 되겠다고 한다
success_text_en: You say you'll become a doctor.

label: 사업가가 되겠다고 한다
success_text_en: You say you'll go into business.
fail_text_en: The teacher questions how realistic it is.

label: 성직자가 되겠다고 한다
success_text_en: You say you'll join the clergy, and even the teacher is impressed.
fail_text_en: Your friends laugh and call you weird.

label: 아직 모르겠다고 한다
success_text_en: You answer that you haven't decided yet.

label: 굶어서 뺀다
success_text_en: You lose weight by starving yourself.
fail_text_en: You collapse and are carried to the nurse's office.

label: 운동으로 뺀다
success_text_en: You run laps and lighten your body.

label: 신경 쓰지 않고 먹는다
success_text_en: You eat whatever you want.
fail_text_en: You put on weight, and your friends tease you.

label: 친구들의 다이어트를 비웃는다
success_text_en: You laugh at your friends.
fail_text_en: You earn the class's resentment.

label: 조용히 다가가 이야기를 들어 준다
success_text_en: Your friend opens up to you.
fail_text: 친구가 말을 아껴 대화가 짧게 끝납니다.
fail_text_en: Your friend says little, and the talk ends quickly.

label: 선생님께 알린다
success_text_en: The teacher keeps an eye on your friend.

label: 친구를 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: You pray quietly for your friend.
fail_text_en: Your prayer doesn't help.

label: 모른 척한다
success_text_en: You walk past, pretending not to know.
fail_text_en: You feel uneasy.

label: 밤낮없이 연구한다
success_text_en: You throw yourself into research day and night.
fail_text_en: Overwork damages your health.

label: 남의 연구를 베낀다
success_text_en: You copy another school's research.
fail_text_en: The plagiarism is exposed, and you're disqualified.

label: 독창적인 발명품으로 수상한다
success_text_en: Your original invention wins an award.
fail_text_en: Your invention doesn't work.

label: 팀원들의 공을 가로챈다
success_text_en: You present your teammates' work as your own.
fail_text_en: Your teammates abandon you.

label: 만점을 받는다
success_text_en: Your clean form earns a perfect score.
fail_text_en: You just hang there, then drop.

label: 매달려만 있다 떨어진다
success_text_en: You drop almost at once.

label: 몰래 하루 백 번씩 연습해 왔다
label_en: You've secretly practiced a hundred times a day
