success_text_en: Steady practice lets you work the bar with ease.
fail_text_en: Your hands blister from all the practice.

label: 시험을 빼먹는다
success_text_en: You skip the test and hide in the classroom.
fail_text_en: You're marked absent and scolded by the teacher.

label: 흥미롭게 읽는다
success_text_en: You're drawn in by the persuasive writing.
fail_text_en: The writing unsettles you, and you close it quickly.

label: 사이비라며 비웃는다
success_text_en: You scoff that it's a cult and move on.

label: 그들의 조직 운영 방식을 분석한다
label_en: Analyze how they run their organization
success_text_en: You analyze how the organization is run.
fail_text_en: The analysis is too complex, and you give up.

label: 직접 찾아가 본다
success_text_en: You visit in person and talk with their followers.
fail_text_en: The followers' pushiness drives you away.

label: 그들을 이끈다
success_text_en: You lead your friends and become the center of the class.
fail_text_en: Your meddling earns resentment.

label: 부담스러워 거리를 둔다
success_text_en: You keep your distance and lie low.

label: 좋은 영향을 주려 노력한다
label_en: Try to be a good influence
success_text_en: You guide your friends with kind words.
fail_text_en: Your efforts fall flat, and you're disappointed.

label: 친구들을 이용해 이득을 챙긴다
success_text_en: You order your friends around for your own gain.
fail_text_en: Your friends turn their backs on you.

label: 병원에서 밤을 새운다
label_en: Stay up all night at the hospital
success_text_en: You keep watch over Grandma all night at the hospital.

label: 기적을 바라며 기도한다
success_text_en: You pray, hoping for a miracle.
fail_text_en: No miracle comes, only heartache.

label: 유산 이야기에 귀를 기울인다
label_en: Listen in on talk of the inheritance
success_text_en: You listen as relatives discuss the inheritance.
fail_text_en: Your relatives glare at you.

label: 할머니와 마지막 대화를 나눈다
label_en: Share a last talk with Grandma
success_text_en: You share a quiet last conversation with Grandma.
fail_text_en: Grandma can't finish her words.

label: 전단지를 돌린다
success_text_en: You earn pocket money handing out flyers.

label: 편의점에서 일한다
success_text_en: Working at a convenience store, you learn to handle money.
fail_text_en: Dealing with customers wears you out.

label: 친척 가게를 돕는다
success_text_en: You help out at a relative's shop.
fail_text_en: There's so much work you never get a break.

label: 나이를 속이고 술집에서 일한다
label_en: Lie about your age and work at a bar
success_text_en: You lie about your age and work at a bar.
fail_text_en: You're found out and fired.

label: 친구들과 밤새 논다
success_text_en: You put on a talent show with friends all night.

label: 몰래 술을 마신다
success_text_en: You drink in secret.
fail_text_en: You drink too much and pass out.

label: 유적지에서 역사를 공부한다
success_text_en: You read the signs at the historic site carefully.
fail_text_en: The explanations at the site bore you.

label: 사찰에서 홀로 참배한다
success_text_en: You pay your respects alone at a Buddhist temple.
fail_text_en: The unfamiliar temple atmosphere makes you tense.

label: 축하해 준다
success_text_en: You congratulate them with a smile.
fail_text_en: You congratulate them, but it stings inside.

label: 몰래 운다
success_text_en: You cry alone to soothe your heart.

label: 이미 늦었다며 포기한다
success_text_en: You give up, telling yourself it's too late.

label: 운동과 공부의 균형을 맞춘다
success_text_en: You keep sports and study in balance.
fail_text_en: Your plans keep falling apart.

label: 친구를 위로한다
success_text_en: You take your friend's hand and comfort them.

label: 그 종교를 조사해 본다
success_text_en: You dig into what the religion really is.
fail_text_en: Your investigation hits a wall, and it frustrates you.

label: 그 종교가 돈을 모으는 방식에 감탄한다
label_en: Admire how that religion raises money
success_text_en: You find yourself wanting to learn their fundraising methods.
fail_text_en: Your friend grows suspicious of you.

label: 친구와 함께 부모님을 설득한다
label_en: Persuade the parents together with your friend
success_text_en: You and your friend try to win over the parents.
fail_text_en: The persuasion fails, and the household erupts.

label: 한판 걸어 본다
success_text_en: You bet a round and win money.
fail_text_en: You lose and end up broke.

label: 속임수를 꿰뚫어 본다
success_text_en: You see right through the scam.
fail_text_en: You miss the trick and lose your money.

label: 판돈을 싹쓸이한다
success_text_en: You sweep the entire pot.
fail_text_en: The game turns, and your money is taken.

label: 지나친다
success_text_en: You simply walk past.

label: 겸손하게 넘긴다
success_text_en: You brush it off with modesty.

label: 유명세를 즐긴다
success_text_en: You accept interviews and enjoy your fame.
fail_text_en: The attention starts to weigh on you.

label: 이 기회로 후원을 받는다
label_en: Use the chance to get sponsorship
success_text_en: The article brings in donations.
fail_text_en: Your request for sponsorship is turned down.

label: 더 많은 선행을 다짐한다
label_en: Vow to do more good deeds
success_text_en: You vow to do even more good.
fail_text_en: The vow begins to feel like a burden.

label: 진솔하게 답한다
success_text_en: Your honest answers win the interviewer's favor.
fail_text_en: Your honesty comes across as weak.

label: 면접관을 말로 압도한다
success_text_en: You overpower the interviewer with your words.
fail_text_en: You go too far, and the interviewer is put off.

label: 긴장해 말을 더듬는다
success_text_en: Nerves make you stammer.

label: 면접관의 취향을 읽고 맞춰 답한다
label_en: Read the interviewer and tailor your answers
success_text_en: You tailor your answers to the interviewer's tastes.
fail_text_en: You misread the interviewer.

label: 받아들인다
success_text_en: You decide to take over the family business.
fail_text_en: The family business weighs on you.

label: 거절하고 내 길을 간다
label_en: Refuse and go your own way
success_text_en: You say you'll follow your own path.
fail_text_en: Your parents are disappointed.

label: 가업의 장부를 살펴본다
success_text_en: You go through the ledgers carefully.

label: 막대한 상속 재산의 존재를 알게 된다
success_text: 장부 깊은 곳에서 상속 재산 기록을 찾아냅니다.
success_text_en: Deep in the ledgers, you find records of an inheritance.
fail_text_en: The records are old and worthless.

label: 병실에서 책을 읽는다
success_text_en: You pass the time reading.

label: 같은 병실 환자들과 친해진다
label_en: Befriend your roommates in the ward
success_text_en: You chat with the other patients.
fail_text_en: The patients' stories weigh heavily on you.

label: 죽음의 공포에 휩싸인다
label_en: Be gripped by fear of death
success_text_en: Fear of death keeps you awake.
fail_text_en: The fear grows, and your health worsens.

label: 병원 기도실을 찾아간다
success_text_en: You pray quietly in the hospital chapel.
fail_text_en: The chapel's silence deepens your loneliness.

label: 바로 독립한다
success_text_en: You pack your bags and move out at once.
fail_text_en: You're clumsy at running a household and struggle.

label: 집에 남는다
success_text_en: You stay with your family.

label: 친구와 함께 산다
success_text_en: You share a home with a friend.
fail_text_en: You and your friend fight over living expenses.

label: 혼자 사는 자유를 만끽한다
label_en: Savor the freedom of living alone
success_text_en: You enjoy the freedom of living alone to the fullest.
fail_text_en: Loneliness creeps in.

label: 어르신들의 이야기를 들어 드린다
success_text_en: You listen to the elders' old stories.

label: 노래로 위문 공연을 한다
success_text_en: You delight the elders with your singing.
fail_text_en: Your singing is awkward, and people laugh.

label: 요양원의 열악함에 분노한다
label_en: Rage at the nursing home's conditions
success_text_en: Outraged by the poor conditions, you demand improvements.
fail_text_en: Your anger makes those around you uncomfortable.

label: 어르신의 손을 잡고 기도한다
label_en: Hold an elder's hand and pray
success_text_en: You hold an elder's hand and pray together.
fail_text_en: The prayer feels heavy.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You refuse firmly.

label: 가입했다가 돈을 잃는다
success_text_en: You join and lose money.
fail_text_en: You lose money and fall into debt.

label: 구조를 꿰뚫고 그 위로 올라선다
label_en: See through the scheme and rise to the top
success_text_en: You figure out the structure and climb above it.
fail_text_en: You get caught in the scheme and are left with only debt.

label: 친구를 빼내 온다
success_text_en: You talk your friend into getting out.
fail_text_en: Your friend won't listen.

label: 원하는 대학에 합격한다
label_en: Get into the university you want
success_text_en: You're accepted to the university you wanted.
fail_text_en: Your name isn't on the list.

label: 낙방한다
success_text_en: You fail to get in and are crushed.

label: 대학 대신 사회로 나간다
label_en: Go into the workforce instead of college
success_text_en: You enter the workforce instead of going to college.
fail_text_en: Your future feels hopeless.

label: 신학대학에 합격한다
success_text_en: You're accepted to a theological college.
fail_text_en: Your path turns out differently than expected.

label: 신의 뜻이라 믿는다
success_text_en: You believe it's God's will.
fail_text_en: Your faith wavers.

label: 운이 좋았을 뿐이다
success_text_en: You tell yourself you were lucky.
fail_text_en: You think about when luck runs out.

label: 남은 삶을 의미 있게 살기로 한다
label_en: Resolve to live the rest of your life meaningfully
success_text: 남은 삶을 의미 있게 살기로 합니다.
success_text_en: You resolve to make the rest of your life count.

label: 그날 이후 이상한 예감이 자주 든다
label_en: Strange premonitions come often after that day
success_text: 이상한 예감이 자주 들어 주변을 살피게 됩니다.
success_text_en: Strange premonitions keep you watching your surroundings.
fail_text_en: The premonitions feed your anxiety.

label: 병원비를 위해 일한다
label_en: Work to pay the hospital bills
success_text_en: You work to pay the hospital bills.
fail_text_en: Overwork takes a toll on your body.

label: 밤낮으로 간호한다
success_text_en: You nurse your father day and night.

label: 기도에 매달린다
success_text_en: You cling to prayer to hold yourself together.
fail_text_en: Prayer brings no comfort.

label: 가장으로서 집안을 책임진다
label_en: Take charge as head of the household
success_text_en: You take on the role of breadwinner.
fail_text_en: The responsibility crushes you.

label: 좋은 선배가 되어 준다
success_text_en: You look after your juniors with care.

label: 후배들을 부린다
success_text_en: You make your juniors do your bidding.
fail_text_en: Your juniors turn their backs on you.

label: 후배들에게 신념을 전한다
label_en: Share your convictions with your juniors
success_text_en: You pass on your convictions.
fail_text_en: Your convictions are so intense they overwhelm your juniors.

label: 귀찮아서 피한다
success_text_en: You avoid your juniors.

label: 담담히 받아들인다
success_text_en: You accept it calmly.

label: 술로 밤을 지새운다
success_text_en: You drink the night away.
fail_text_en: You drink too much and pass out.

label: 일에 몰두한다
success_text_en: You throw yourself into work.
fail_text_en: You can't concentrate on work.

label: 이별을 신의 시련이라 여긴다
label_en: See the breakup as a trial from God
success_text_en: You accept the breakup as a divine trial.
fail_text_en: Thinking of it as a trial only hurts more.

label: 세상을 바꾸고 싶다고 말한다
label_en: Say you want to change the world
success_text_en: You declare your will to change the world.
fail_text_en: Your friends laugh that it's unrealistic.

label: 행복하게만 살고 싶다고 말한다
label_en: Say you just want to be happy
success_text_en: You speak of simple happiness.

label: 돈을 많이 벌고 싶다고 말한다
label_en: Say you want to make a lot of money
success_text_en: You say you want to make a lot of money.
fail_text_en: Your friends smile bitterly.

label: 신을 만나고 싶다고 말한다
label_en: Say you want to meet God
success_text_en: You say you want to meet God.
fail_text_en: Your friends don't take you seriously.

label: 연구한다
success_text_en: You study the texts closely.
fail_text_en: The writing is too difficult, and you give up.

label: 불태운다
success_text_en: You burn the book.

label: 비싸게 팔아넘긴다
label_en: Sell it for a high price
success_text_en: You sell it to an antique dealer for a high price.
fail_text_en: You're suspected of selling a fake antique.

label: 의식을 실제로 해 본다
success_text_en: You actually perform the ritual.
fail_text_en: The ritual feels terrifying.

label: 체력을 단련한다
success_text_en: You train your body.

label: 신앙을 다진다
success_text_en: You strengthen your faith.
fail_text_en: Your faith wavers.

label: 친구들과 마지막으로 논다
label_en: Hang out with friends one last time
success_text_en: You have a great time with your friends one last time.
fail_text_en: Staying out late leaves you exhausted.

label: 계획표를 세운다
success_text_en: You draw up a schedule.
fail_text_en: Your plan falls apart.

label: 응급 처치를 한다
success_text: 응급 처치를 해 노인을 살려 냅니다.
success_text_en: Your first aid saves the old man's life.
fail_text_en: Your first aid is clumsy, and the old man struggles.

label: 구급차를 부른다
success_text_en: You call an ambulance to take the old man away.

label: 노인의 지갑에 손을 댄다
label_en: Reach for the old man's wallet
success_text_en: You reach for his wallet.
fail_text_en: A witness appears, and you flee.

label: 노인의 손을 잡고 기도한다
label_en: Hold the old man's hand and pray
success_text_en: You hold the old man's hand and pray.
fail_text_en: The old man never wakes up.

label: 웃어넘긴다
success_text_en: You laugh it off.

label: 그 말을 가슴에 새긴다
label_en: Engrave the words on your heart
success_text: 그 말을 가슴에 새기고 목표를 세웁니다.
success_text_en: You take the words to heart and set a goal.
fail_text_en: The words linger as a burden.

label: 노인에게 자세히 묻는다
success_text_en: You listen closely to the old man's story.
fail_text_en: The old man's words are vague.

label: 무리를 이끄는 법을 공부한다
label_en: Study how to lead a crowd
success_text_en: You study how to lead a group of people.
fail_text_en: The study leaves you at a loss.

label: 참고 견딘다
success_text_en: You endure it in silence.

label: 당당히 항의한다
success_text_en: You protest openly.
fail_text_en: You fall out of your boss's favor.

label: 동료들을 모아 맞선다
label_en: Rally your coworkers to stand up
success_text_en: You gather your coworkers and stand up together.
fail_text_en: Your coworkers turn their backs on you.

label: 그만두고 나온다
success_text_en: You quit and walk out.
fail_text_en: Money is tight until you find your next job.

label: 옛 목사님과 이야기를 나눈다
success_text_en: You reminisce with your old pastor.

label: 텅 빈 예배당에서 홀로 기도한다
label_en: Pray alone in the empty chapel
success_text_en: You pray alone in the empty chapel.
fail_text_en: The silence deepens your loneliness.

label: 교회가 쇠락한 이유를 분석한다
success_text_en: You analyze why the church fell into decline.
fail_text_en: The analysis leaves a bitter taste.

label: 헌금함을 바라본다
success_text_en: You gaze at the offering box, lost in thought.
fail_text_en: Your hand drifts toward the offering box.

label: 그 힘을 선하게 쓴다
success_text_en: You use that power for good.
fail_text_en: Your will to use it for good falls short.

label: 그 힘으로 사람을 움직여 본다
label_en: Try moving people with that power
success_text_en: You use that power to move people.
fail_text_en: People feel they've been manipulated.

label: 두려워 말을 아낀다
label_en: Hold your tongue out of fear
success_text_en: You keep your words to yourself.

label: 신이 주신 재능이라 믿는다
success_text_en: You believe it's a gift from God.
fail_text_en: Being called gifted weighs on you.

label: 가족과 조촐히 보낸다
success_text_en: You celebrate modestly with your family.

label: 성대한 파티를 연다
success_text_en: You invite your friends to a lavish party.
fail_text_en: The cost of the party weighs on you.

label: 홀로 산에 올라 기도한다
label_en: Climb a mountain alone to pray
success_text_en: You climb a mountain alone and pray.
fail_text_en: The climb is hard and wears you out.

label: 앞으로의 계획을 세운다
success_text_en: You make plans for the future.
fail_text_en: Your plans are hazy.

label: 스스로 답을 찾겠다고 다짐한다
label_en: Vow to find the answer yourself
success_text_en: You vow to find the answer on your own.
fail_text_en: No answer appears, and your doubts deepen.

label: 여러 경전을 탐독한다
success_text_en: You devour scripture after scripture.
fail_text_en: The more you read, the more confused you become.

label: 신비 체험을 갈구한다
success_text_en: You yearn for a mystical experience.
fail_text_en: Hollow experiences leave you disappointed.

label: 사람들의 고통에 귀를 기울인다
success_text_en: You lend an ear to people's suffering.
